191: 
192: def check_and_send_reminders():
193:     """
194:     Check for documents and subscriptions expiring soon and send reminders.
195:     Called by cron-job.org daily.
196:     """
197:     print(f"🔄 Running daily reminder check at {datetime.now(timezone.utc)}")
198:     
199:     # 1. Check document reminders (existing functionality)
200:     check_document_reminders()
201:     
202:     # 2. Check subscription reminders (new)
203:     check_subscription_reminders()
204:     
205:     print("✅ Reminder check complete")
206: 
207: def check_document_reminders():
208:     """Find documents that need reminders and send emails."""
209:     conn = get_db()
210:     try:
211:         cursor = conn.cursor()
212: 
213:         today = datetime.today().date()
214: 
215:         # Find all users with expiring documents
216:         cursor.execute("""
217:             SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email
218:             FROM users u
219:             JOIN documents d ON u.id = d.user_id
220:             WHERE d.expiry_date::date <= %s + INTERVAL '6 months'
221:         """, (today,))
222: 
223:         users = cursor.fetchall()
224: 
225:         for user_id, email in users:
226:             # Get all documents expiring within 120 days
227:             cursor.execute("""
228:                 SELECT id, title, expiry_date::date,
229:                        (expiry_date::date - %s) as days_left
230:                 FROM documents
231:                 WHERE user_id = %s
232:                 AND expiry_date::date <= %s + INTERVAL '120 days'
233:                 ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
234:             """, (today, user_id, today))
235: 
236:             docs = cursor.fetchall()
237: 
238:             if not docs:
239:                 continue
240: 
241:             # Categorize based on thresholds
242:             critical = []      # 0-7 days
243:             urgent = []        # 8-60 days
244:             warning = []       # 61-120 days
245:             expired = []       # <0 days
246: 
247:             for doc_id, title, expiry_date, days_left in docs:
248:                 doc = {
249:                     'id': doc_id,
250:                     'title': title,
251:                     'expiry_date': expiry_date,
252:                     'days_left': days_left
253:                 }
254: 
255:                 if days_left < 0:
256:                     expired.append(doc)
257:                 elif days_left <= 7:
258:                     critical.append(doc)
259:                 elif days_left <= 60:
260:                     urgent.append(doc)
261:                 else:
262:                     warning.append(doc)
263: 
264:             # Send expired emails daily (same as critical)
265:             if expired:
266:                 send_reminder_email(email, expired, "EXPIRED")
267:             elif critical:
268:                 send_reminder_email(email, critical, "CRITICAL")
269:             elif urgent:
270:                 # Check if it's been at least 7 days since last reminder
271:                 cursor.execute("""
272:                     SELECT MAX(last_reminder_sent) FROM documents
273:                     WHERE user_id = %s AND expiry_date::date <= %s + INTERVAL '90 days'
274:                 """, (user_id, today))
275:                 last_reminder = cursor.fetchone()[0]
276: 
277:                 if not last_reminder or (today - last_reminder).days >= 7:
278:                     sent = send_reminder_email(email, urgent, "URGENT")
279:                     if sent:
280:                         for doc in urgent:
281:                             cursor.execute(
282:                                 "UPDATE documents SET last_reminder_sent = %s WHERE id = %s",
283:                                 (today, doc['id'])
284:                             )
285:             elif warning:
286:                 # Monthly reminder
287:                 cursor.execute("""
288:                     SELECT MAX(last_reminder_sent) FROM documents
289:                     WHERE user_id = %s AND expiry_date::date <= %s + INTERVAL '180 days'
290:                 """, (user_id, today))
291:                 last_reminder = cursor.fetchone()[0]
292: 
293:                 if not last_reminder or (today - last_reminder).days >= 30:
294:                     sent = send_reminder_email(email, warning, "WARNING")
295:                     if sent:
296:                         for doc in warning:
297:                             cursor.execute(
298:                                 "UPDATE documents SET last_reminder_sent = %s WHERE id = %s",
299:                                 (today, doc['id'])
300:                             )
301: 
302:             conn.commit()
303: 
304:         cursor.close()
305:     except Exception as e:
306:         print(f"❌ Error checking document reminders: {e}")
307:     finally:
308:         conn.close()
309: 
310: def check_subscription_reminders():
311:     """Check for subscriptions/trials expiring soon and send email reminders."""
312:     conn = get_db()
313:     try:
314:         cursor = conn.cursor()
315:         
316:         cursor.execute("""
317:             SELECT id, email, subscription_tier, subscription_expiry, trial_ends_at, trial_used
318:             FROM users 
319:             WHERE subscription_tier IN ('pro', 'vip')
320:             AND subscription_status = 'active'
321:         """)
322:         users = cursor.fetchall()
323:         
324:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
325:         today = now.date()
326:         
327:         for user in users:
328:             user_id, email, tier, expiry, trial_ends_at, trial_used = user
329:             
330:             # Make all datetimes timezone-aware
331:             if expiry and expiry.tzinfo is None:
332:                 expiry = expiry.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
333:             if trial_ends_at and trial_ends_at.tzinfo is None:
334:                 trial_ends_at = trial_ends_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
335:             
336:             is_trial = trial_used and trial_ends_at and trial_ends_at > now
337:             
338:             if is_trial:
339:                 # Trial reminder - send at 2 days and 1 day before
340:                 days_left = (trial_ends_at - now).days
341:                 
342:                 # Check if we already sent a reminder today
343:                 cursor.execute("""
344:                     SELECT 1 FROM user_activity_logs 
345:                     WHERE user_id = %s 
346:                     AND action = 'trial_reminder_sent' 
347:                     AND created_at::date = %s
348:                 """, (user_id, today))
349:                 already_sent = cursor.fetchone()
350:                 
351:                 if days_left in [2, 1] and not already_sent:
352:                     success = send_subscription_reminder_email(
353:                         email, 
354:                         email.split('@')[0], 
355:                         tier, 
356:                         trial_ends_at, 
357:                         is_trial=True
358:                     )
359:                     if success:
360:                         # Log that we sent the reminder
361:                         cursor.execute("""
362:                             INSERT INTO user_activity_logs (user_id, action, details, created_at)
363:                             VALUES (%s, 'trial_reminder_sent', %s, %s)
364:                         """, (user_id, json.dumps({'days_left': days_left, 'tier': tier}), now))
365:                         conn.commit()
366:                         print(f"📧 Sent trial reminder to {email} ({days_left} days left)")
367:             
368:             elif expiry and expiry > now:
369:                 # Regular subscription reminder - send at 7, 2, and 1 days before
370:                 days_left = (expiry - now).days
371:                 
372:                 # Check if we already sent a reminder today
373:                 cursor.execute("""
374:                     SELECT 1 FROM user_activity_logs 
375:                     WHERE user_id = %s 
376:                     AND action = 'subscription_reminder_sent' 
377:                     AND created_at::date = %s
378:                 """, (user_id, today))
379:                 already_sent = cursor.fetchone()
380:                 
381:                 if days_left in [7, 2, 1] and not already_sent:
382:                     success = send_subscription_reminder_email(
383:                         email, 
384:                         email.split('@')[0], 
385:                         tier, 
386:                         expiry, 
387:                         is_trial=False
388:                     )
389:                     if success:
390:                         # Log that we sent the reminder
391:                         cursor.execute("""
392:                             INSERT INTO user_activity_logs (user_id, action, details, created_at)
393:                             VALUES (%s, 'subscription_reminder_sent', %s, %s)
394:                         """, (user_id, json.dumps({'days_left': days_left, 'tier': tier}), now))
395:                         conn.commit()
396:                         print(f"📧 Sent subscription reminder to {email} ({days_left} days left)")
397:         
398:         cursor.close()
399:         
400:     except Exception as e:
401:         print(f"❌ Error checking subscription reminders: {e}")
402:         import traceback
403:         traceback.print_exc()
404:     finally:
405:         conn.close()
406: 
407: if __name__ == "__main__":
408:     check_and_send_reminders()

 85: {% block content %}
 86: 
 87: <article class="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
 88:   <p class="text-xs text-muted mb-2">Guide · 6 min read</p>
 89:   <h1 class="font-display font-bold text-3xl md:text-4xl mb-4">
 90:     The Document Expiry Tracking Checklist
 91:   </h1>
 92:   <p class="text-lg text-muted mb-8">
 93:     Print this. Tick it off. Never get surprised by an expired document again.
 94:     Every item below has an expiry date — the question is whether you know what it is.
 95:   </p>
 96: 
 97:   <img src="/static/resources/document-checklist-categories.svg" alt="Four categories of documents to track: personal, business, financial and insurance, and digital" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-line mb-8" width="700" height="200" loading="lazy">
 98: 
 99:   <div class="bg-paper border border-line rounded-xl p-6 mb-8">
100:     <p class="text-sm text-ink">
101:       <strong>How to use this checklist:</strong> Go through each category, note the expiry
102:       date for anything you own or hold, and add it to a tracker (or a calendar — but ideally
103:       a tracker, so you get reminders automatically). Documents you don't track are the ones
104:       that expire on you.
105:     </p>
106:   </div>
107: 
108:   <!-- ======================= PERSONAL ======================= -->
109:   <section class="mb-10">
110:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-line">
111:       👤 Personal Documents
112:     </h2>
113:     <p class="text-ink mb-4">
114:       The documents tied to your identity and ability to travel. These are the ones with the
115:       longest renewal times — and the harshest consequences for missing.
116:     </p>
117:     <ul class="space-y-3 mb-6">
118:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
119:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
120:         <div>
121:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Passport</p>
122:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Renew 9–12 months before expiry. Most countries require 6 months of validity beyond your return date. <a href="/resources/passport-expiration-reminder" class="text-fritt hover:underline">Full guide →</a></p>
123:         </div>
124:       </li>
125:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
126:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
127:         <div>
128:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Visas (tourist, work, student, residence)</p>
129:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Each has its own expiry and renewal process. Track them separately from your passport.</p>
130:         </div>
131:       </li>
132:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
133:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
134:         <div>
135:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Driver's license</p>
136:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Check whether your jurisdiction allows online renewal or requires an in-person visit — in-person can mean weeks of lead time.</p>
137:         </div>
138:       </li>
139:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
140:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
141:         <div>
142:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">International driving permit (IDP)</p>
143:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Valid for 1 year from issue. Easy to forget if you only travel occasionally.</p>
144:         </div>
145:       </li>
146:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
147:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
148:         <div>
149:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">National ID card</p>
150:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Required for domestic travel, banking, and government services in most countries.</p>
151:         </div>
152:       </li>
153:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
154:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
155:         <div>
156:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Vehicle registration &amp; inspection</p>
157:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Registration renews annually or biannually; inspections are often required before registration can be renewed.</p>
158:         </div>
159:       </li>
160:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
161:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
162:         <div>
163:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Professional certifications</p>
164:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Medical, legal, contractor, teaching, real estate — most require continuing education credits before renewal.</p>
165:         </div>
166:       </li>
167:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
168:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
169:         <div>
170:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Trusted traveller programmes (Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, NEXUS)</p>
171:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Memberships expire every 5 years. Renewal can take months to process.</p>
172:         </div>
173:       </li>
174:     </ul>
175:   </section>
176: 
177:   <!-- ======================= BUSINESS ======================= -->
178:   <section class="mb-10">
179:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-line">
180:       🏢 Business &amp; Compliance Documents
181:     </h2>
182:     <p class="text-ink mb-4">
183:       If you run a business, these are the ones with the highest penalty for a missed renewal —
184:       fines, forced closures, or lost contracts. See our
185:       <a href="/use-cases/business-licenses" class="text-fritt hover:underline">business license tracking page</a>
186:       for a deeper look.
187:     </p>
188:     <ul class="space-y-3 mb-6">
189:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
190:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
191:         <div>
192:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Business operating license</p>
193:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Issued by your local or national authority. Renewal windows are often strict. <a href="/resources/how-to-track-business-license-renewal" class="text-fritt hover:underline">Full guide →</a></p>
194:         </div>
195:       </li>
196:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
197:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
198:         <div>
199:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Sales tax / VAT registration</p>
200:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Re-registration is required in some jurisdictions, even if the number itself doesn't change.</p>
201:         </div>
202:       </li>
203:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
204:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
205:         <div>
206:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Health &amp; safety inspections</p>
207:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Restaurants, salons, gyms, and any physical location — inspection certificates usually expire annually.</p>
208:         </div>
209:       </li>
210:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
211:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
212:         <div>
213:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Professional / industry certifications</p>
214:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Required to legally operate in some industries — legal, medical, financial, construction.</p>
215:         </div>
216:       </li>
217:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
218:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
219:         <div>
220:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Building permits &amp; occupancy certificates</p>
221:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Often overlooked after the initial build. Some require periodic renewal.</p>
222:         </div>
223:       </li>
224:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
225:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
226:         <div>
227:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Import / export licenses</p>
228:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Customs and trade authorisations, especially for regulated goods.</p>
229:         </div>
230:       </li>
231:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
232:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
233:         <div>
234:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Environmental or waste permits</p>
235:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Required for many industrial and agricultural operations.</p>
236:         </div>
237:       </li>
238:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
239:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
240:         <div>
241:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Fire safety certificates</p>
242:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Usually annual. Your landlord may hold it, but you're still required to comply.</p>
243:         </div>
244:       </li>
245:     </ul>
246:   </section>

248:   <!-- ======================= FINANCIAL & INSURANCE ======================= -->
249:   <section class="mb-10">
250:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-line">
251:       💰 Financial, Insurance &amp; Legal
252:     </h2>
253:     <p class="text-ink mb-4">
254:       A lapsed policy or a missed renewal window here can cost you a claim, a contract, or
255:       serious money. See our <a href="/use-cases/insurance" class="text-fritt hover:underline">insurance tracking page</a>
256:       for the full picture on coverage gaps.
257:     </p>
258:     <ul class="space-y-3 mb-6">

261:         <div>
262:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">General liability insurance</p>
263:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Required by most B2B contracts and commercial leases. Renewal notices often go to old addresses.</p>
264:         </div>
265:       </li>

267:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>

271:         </div>
272:       </li>

274:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
275:         <div>
276:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Workers' compensation</p>
277:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Legally required in most jurisdictions if you have employees. Non-negotiable.</p>
278:         </div>
279:       </li>
280:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
281:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>

283:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Commercial auto &amp; property insurance</p>
284:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Both renew annually. Premiums change — check the renewal quote before auto-renewing.</p>
285:         </div>
286:       </li>
287:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
288:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
289:         <div>
290:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Cyber liability &amp; D&amp;O insurance</p>
291:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Increasingly required by enterprise clients, boards, and investors.</p>
292:         </div>
293:       </li>

296:         <div>
297:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Vendor certificates of insurance (COIs)</p>
298:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">You need to track <em>their</em> expiry dates too. <a href="/resources/insurance-coverage-gaps" class="text-fritt hover:underline">Full guide →</a></p>
299:         </div>
300:       </li>
301:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
302:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
303:         <div>
304:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Home / renters insurance</p>
305:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Personal policies expire annually. Check that contents coverage still matches what you own.</p>
306:         </div>
307:       </li>
308:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
309:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
310:         <div>
311:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Contract renewals &amp; cancellation windows</p>
312:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Track the cancellation deadline, not the end date. <a href="/resources/contract-renewal-tracking" class="text-fritt hover:underline">Full guide →</a></p>
313:         </div>
314:       </li>
315:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
316:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
317:         <div>
318:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Commercial lease &amp; property agreements</p>
319:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Renewal windows are typically 90–180 days before the end date.</p>
320:         </div>
321:       </li>
322:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
323:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
324:         <div>
325:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Credit card expirations</p>
326:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Easy to miss, and a failure point for auto-payments (see Digital below).</p>
327:         </div>
328:       </li>
329:     </ul>
330:   </section>

332:   <!-- ======================= DIGITAL ======================= -->
333:   <section class="mb-10">
334:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-line">
335:       💻 Digital Assets &amp; Infrastructure
336:     </h2>
337:     <p class="text-ink mb-4">
338:       These are the silent killers. Nothing makes your website, email, or app stop working
339:       faster than an expired certificate or domain — and they always expire on a Friday.
340:     </p>
341:     <ul class="space-y-3 mb-6">
342:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
343:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
344:         <div>
345:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Domain names</p>
346:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Set to auto-renew, but also track the expiry — auto-renew fails silently if the card on file expired.</p>
347:         </div>
348:       </li>
349:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
350:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
351:         <div>
352:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">SSL / TLS certificates</p>
353:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Now often auto-renewed (Let's Encrypt, etc.) but worth tracking. Manual certs expire on a 1-year cycle.</p>
354:         </div>
355:       </li>
356:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
357:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
358:         <div>
359:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Software licenses</p>
360:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Desktop software, design tools, and industry-specific programs often use annual licenses.</p>
361:         </div>
362:       </li>
363:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
364:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
365:         <div>
366:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">SaaS subscriptions</p>
367:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Every tool has a renewal date. Track the ones with annual terms — those are the ones where you have leverage to negotiate.</p>
368:         </div>
369:       </li>
370:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
371:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
372:         <div>
373:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">API keys &amp; access tokens</p>
374:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Many have expiration policies (30, 90, or 365 days). Track them if they don't auto-rotate.</p>
375:         </div>
376:       </li>
377:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
378:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
379:         <div>
380:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Cloud hosting &amp; CDN contracts</p>
381:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Annual reserved instances and committed-use discounts renew on a fixed date.</p>
382:         </div>
383:       </li>
384:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
385:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
386:         <div>
387:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Trademarks &amp; patents</p>
388:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Renewal cycles vary by jurisdiction (often 10 years for trademarks), but missing a renewal can mean losing the mark entirely.</p>
389:         </div>
390:       </li>
391:       <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
392:         <span class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-muted rounded flex-shrink-0"></span>
393:         <div>
394:           <p class="font-medium text-ink">Business bank account verifications</p>
395:           <p class="text-sm text-muted">Some jurisdictions require periodic re-verification. Missing it can freeze the account.</p>
396:         </div>
397:       </li>
398:     </ul>
399:   </section>
400: 
401:   <!-- ======================= SETUP ======================= -->
402:   <section class="mb-10">
403:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-line">
404:       ✅ How to set this up in 10 minutes
405:     </h2>
406:     <p class="text-ink mb-4">
407:       A checklist is only useful if the dates end up somewhere that will remind you.
408:       Here's the process:
409:     </p>
410:     <ol class="list-decimal pl-6 space-y-3 mb-6 text-ink">
411:       <li>
412:         <strong>Gather the documents.</strong> Physically or digitally — pull out everything
413:         on the list above. A folder, a filing cabinet, a password manager, wherever they live.
414:       </li>
415:       <li>
416:         <strong>Note every expiry date.</strong> Write them on a piece of paper as you go.
417:         Don't try to organise them yet — just get the dates.
418:       </li>
419:       <li>
420:         <strong>Add them to a tracker.</strong> A calendar works, but only if you set multiple
421:         reminders per item — which is tedious. A dedicated tracker does this automatically and
422:         shows everything on one dashboard.
423:       </li>
424:       <li>
425:         <strong>Set your reminder rules.</strong> For anything with a renewal process (passport,
426:         license), 90 days is a good minimum. For anything that just needs a payment, 30 days is fine.
427:         For anything critical (insurance, business license), 90 days minimum.
428:       </li>
429:       <li>
430:         <strong>Review quarterly.</strong> Once every 3 months, open the dashboard and check
431:         what's expiring in the next 90 days. This is where you catch problems before they
432:         become emergencies.
433:       </li>
434:     </ol>
435:   </section>

449:   <!-- ======================= FAQ (good for SEO) ======================= -->
450:   <section class="mt-12">
451:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4">Frequently asked questions</h2>
452: 
453:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
454:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">How often should I review my expiry dates?</summary>
455:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
456:         Quarterly. Anything more frequent is overkill for most people; anything less and you'll
457:         miss renewal windows that open 60–90 days before expiry.
458:       </p>
459:     </details>
460: 
461:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
462:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">What's the single most important document to track?</summary>
463:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
464:         For individuals: your passport. For businesses: your business license and general
465:         liability insurance. Both have long renewal lead times and severe consequences for
466:         missing them.
467:       </p>
468:     </details>
469: 
470:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
471:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">Can I just use a spreadsheet?</summary>
472:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
473:         You can, but spreadsheets are passive — they don't remind you. They also live on one
474:         device, which fails as soon as more than one person is involved. A dedicated tracker
475:         is worth it once you're tracking more than a handful of items.
476:       </p>
477:     </details>
478: 
479:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
480:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">How far in advance should I set reminders?</summary>
481:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
482:         90 days for anything with a renewal process (passports, licenses, insurance,
483:         certifications). 30 days for anything that's just a payment. 7 days as a final
484:         failsafe for everything.
485:       </p>
486:     </details>
487: 
488:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
489:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">Does Fritt Tracker work for businesses with multiple people?</summary>
490:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
491:         Currently each Fritt Tracker account is single-user. Multi-user team sharing is on
492:         the roadmap. For now, most small teams use a shared account on the Pro plan to track
493:         company-wide documents.
494:       </p>
495:     </details>

 77: {% block content %}
 78: 
 79: <article class="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
 80:   <p class="text-xs text-muted mb-2">Business · 8 min read</p>
 81:   <h1 class="font-display font-bold text-3xl md:text-4xl mb-4">
 82:     Contract Renewal Tracking: How to Escape the Auto-Renewal Trap
 83:   </h1>
 84:   <p class="text-lg text-muted mb-8">
 85:     Auto-renewals are great until they're not. Here's how to track every renewal and cancellation
 86:     window so you're never surprised by a charge — or stuck in a contract you forgot about.
 87:   </p>
 88: 
 89:   <img src="/static/resources/contract-renewal-diagram.svg" alt="Timeline diagram showing the cancellation deadline falls before the contract end date, separated by the notice period" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-line mb-8" width="700" height="260" loading="lazy">
 90: 
 91:   <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-3">Why auto-renewals catch people out</h2>
 92:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
 93:     An auto-renewal clause is a contract term that says: <em>if neither party cancels within a
 94:     certain window, the contract renews for another term.</em> It's designed to protect the
 95:     vendor from lapsed revenue — but it puts the burden on you to remember the cancellation
 96:     window, which is often 30, 60, or 90 days before the renewal date.
 97:   </p>
 98:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
 99:     The trap works like this:
100:   </p>
101:   <ol class="list-decimal pl-6 space-y-2 mb-6 text-ink">
102:     <li>You sign a 12-month contract on January 15.</li>
103:     <li>The contract auto-renews unless cancelled 60 days before the end date.</li>
104:     <li>Your real cancellation deadline is <strong>November 16</strong>.</li>
105:     <li>You think about it in December, decide to cancel, and discover you're locked in for another 12 months.</li>
106:   </ol>
107:   <p class="text-ink mb-6">
108:     Multiply that by every SaaS tool, vendor agreement, insurance policy, and client contract
109:     you've signed, and the "I'll remember" system collapses fast.
110:   </p>
111: 
112:   <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-3">The three types of auto-renewal traps</h2>
113: 
114:   <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-6 mb-2">1. Fixed-term auto-renewal</h3>
115:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
116:     The contract runs for a set term (12 months, 24 months) and renews for an identical term
117:     unless cancelled in the window. This is the most common in B2B SaaS, insurance, and
118:     property leases. The cancellation window is usually 30–90 days before the end date.
119:   </p>
120: 
121:   <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-6 mb-2">2. Evergreen contracts</h3>
122:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
123:     Month-to-month contracts that renew continuously unless cancelled. Common in software
124:     subscriptions and managed services. These are easier to exit but harder to remember,
125:     because there's no "end date" — you just keep paying.
126:   </p>
127: 
128:   <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-6 mb-2">3. Rollover with price escalation</h3>
129:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
130:     The nastiest of the three. The contract renews automatically <em>and</em> includes a
131:     built-in price increase (often 3–7% per year). By the time you notice, you've been
132:     overpaying for two years. Common in enterprise software, managed hosting, and
133:     professional services retainers.
134:   </p>
135: 
136:   <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-3">The cancellation window math</h2>
137:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
138:     This is where most people get it wrong. The date you need to remember is <strong>not</strong>
139:     the contract end date. It's:
140:   </p>
141:   <p class="text-ink mb-6 font-mono text-sm bg-paper border border-line rounded-md p-4">
142:     Cancellation deadline = End date − Notice period
143:   </p>
144:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
145:     Examples:
146:   </p>
147:   <ul class="list-disc pl-6 space-y-2 mb-6 text-ink">
148:     <li>Contract ends December 31, 90-day notice → cancel by <strong>October 2</strong>.</li>
149:     <li>Contract ends March 15, 60-day notice → cancel by <strong>January 14</strong>.</li>
150:     <li>Contract ends June 30, 30-day notice → cancel by <strong>May 31</strong>.</li>
151:   </ul>
152:   <p class="text-ink mb-6">
153:     If your contract also has a "notice of non-renewal" requirement (some do, on top of the
154:     cancellation window), you need to be even earlier. Read the fine print carefully and
155:     treat the earliest deadline as your real one.
156:   </p>
157: 
158:   <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-3">How to track contract renewals</h2>
159:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
160:     The system that works has three parts:
161:   </p>
162: 
163:   <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-6 mb-2">1. Inventory every contract with an end date</h3>
164:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
165:     Go through your contracts and list every one with:
166:   </p>
167:   <ul class="list-disc pl-6 space-y-2 mb-4 text-ink">
168:     <li>Vendor / counterparty name</li>
169:     <li>Contract end date</li>
170:     <li>Cancellation notice period (in days)</li>
171:     <li>Renewal term length (if it auto-renews)</li>
172:     <li>Any price escalation clause</li>
173:   </ul>
174:   <p class="text-ink mb-6">
175:     Don't skip this step. Half of the "missed renewal" problem is not knowing what you've
176:     actually signed.
177:   </p>
178: 
179:   <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-6 mb-2">2. Track the cancellation deadline, not the end date</h3>
180:   <p class="text-ink mb-4">
181:     When you add a contract to your tracker, subtract the notice period from the end date
182:     and track <em>that</em> date. This is the date the reminder should fire.
183:   </p>
184:   <p class="text-ink mb-6">
185:     Better yet: set multiple reminders — 90 days, 30 days, and 7 days before the cancellation
186:     deadline. That gives you time to decide, negotiate, or shop alternatives.
187:   </p>
188: 
189:   <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-6 mb-2">3. Review quarterly</h3>
190:   <p class="text-ink mb-6">
191:     Once a quarter, pull up your list of contracts renewing in the next 12 months. Ask:
192:     do we still need this? Is the price still competitive? Would the vendor negotiate?
193:     This turns contract tracking from a defensive exercise into a cost-saving one.
194:   </p>
195: 
196:   <div class="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-6 my-8">
197:     <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mb-2">Never miss a cancellation window again</h3>
198:     <p class="text-sm text-ink mb-4">
199:       Fritt Tracker sends you email reminders before every contract renewal and cancellation
200:       deadline. Free for up to 20 documents. Pro is {{ pricing.currency }}{{ pricing.monthly }}/month for 100.
201:     </p>
202:     <a href="/register" class="inline-block px-5 py-2.5 rounded-md bg-fritt text-white font-medium text-sm hover:bg-fritt-dark transition-colors">
203:       Track my contracts free →
204:     </a>
205:   </div>
206: 
207:   <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-3">A quick audit you can do today</h2>
208:   <ol class="list-decimal pl-6 space-y-2 mb-6 text-ink">
209:     <li>Open your last 3 months of bank or card statements.</li>
210:     <li>Circle every recurring charge you don't immediately recognise.</li>
211:     <li>For each one, find the contract or terms and note the cancellation window.</li>
212:     <li>Add the cancellation deadline to your calendar — or better, to a tracker.</li>
213:     <li>Cancel anything you're not actively using. Most people find 2–4 subscriptions they'd forgotten about.</li>
214:   </ol>
215:   <p class="text-ink mb-6">
216:     Even if you don't cancel anything, knowing what's renewing and when is worth the audit.
217:     It's the difference between paying attention and paying for it.
218:   </p>
219: 
220:   <!-- ======================= FAQ (matches FAQPage schema above) ======================= -->
221:   <section class="mt-12">
222:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl mt-8 mb-4">Frequently asked questions</h2>
223: 
224:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
225:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">What is an auto-renewal clause?</summary>
226:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
227:         An auto-renewal clause is a contract term stating the agreement automatically renews
228:         for another term unless either party cancels within a set notice window, often 30 to
229:         90 days before the end date.
230:       </p>
231:     </details>
232: 
233:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
234:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">What date should I actually track for a contract renewal?</summary>
235:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
236:         Track the cancellation deadline, not the contract end date. The cancellation deadline
237:         is the end date minus the notice period, and it's the date your reminder should fire.
238:       </p>
239:     </details>
240: 
241:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
242:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">How many reminders should I set before a contract renewal?</summary>
243:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
244:         Set at least three: 90 days, 30 days, and 7 days before the cancellation deadline.
245:         That gives you time to decide, renegotiate, or shop alternatives.
246:       </p>
247:     </details>
248: 
249:     <details class="border-b border-line py-4">
250:       <summary class="font-medium cursor-pointer">How often should I review my recurring contracts?</summary>
251:       <p class="text-sm text-ink mt-3">
252:         Quarterly. Pull up every contract renewing in the next 12 months and ask whether you
253:         still need it and whether the price is still competitive.
254:       </p>
255:     </details>
256:   </section>
257: 
258:   <div class="mt-12 pt-8 border-t border-line">
259:     <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-xl mb-4">Keep reading</h2>
260:     <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
261:       {% for a in articles if a.slug != 'contract-renewal-tracking' %}
262:       <a href="/resources/{{ a.slug }}" class="block bg-white border border-line rounded-lg p-4 hover:border-fritt transition-colors">
263:         <div class="text-xs text-muted mb-1">{{ a.category }}</div>
264:         <div class="font-medium text-sm">{{ a.title }}</div>
265:       </a>
266:       {% endfor %}
267:     </div>
268:   </div>
269: </article>
270: 
271: {% endblock %}

140: <section id="how-it-works" class="py-16 bg-white border-t border-line">
141:   <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-3xl text-center mb-4">How It Works</h2>
142:   <p class="text-center text-muted mb-12">Three simple steps to never miss a renewal again.</p>
143:   
144:   <div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
145:     <!-- Step 1 -->
146:     <div class="text-center">
147:       <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-fritt text-white text-2xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">1</div>

265: <!-- Toggle JavaScript -->
266: <script>
267: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
268:     const toggle = document.getElementById('billing-toggle');
269:     const monthlyPrices = document.querySelectorAll('.monthly-price');
270:     const annualPrices = document.querySelectorAll('.annual-price');
271:     const monthlyBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.monthly-btn');
272:     const annualBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.annual-btn');
273:     const monthlyLabels = document.querySelectorAll('.monthly-label');
274:     const annualLabels = document.querySelectorAll('.annual-label');
275:     
276:     toggle.addEventListener('change', function() {
277:         if (this.checked) {
278:             // Show annual, hide monthly
279:             monthlyPrices.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
280:             annualPrices.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'block');
281:             monthlyBtns.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
282:             annualBtns.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'block');
283:         } else {
284:             // Show monthly, hide annual
285:             monthlyPrices.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'block');
286:             annualPrices.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
287:             monthlyBtns.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'block');
288:             annualBtns.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
289:         }
290:     });
291: });
292: </script>
293: {% endblock %}
