 827: def cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id):
 828:     """
 829:     Cancel a user's Flutterwave subscription if they have one.
 830:     Returns True if successful or no subscription exists, False if there was an error.
 831:     """
 832:     conn = get_db()
 833:     try:
 834:         cursor = conn.cursor()
 835:         cursor.execute(
 836:             "SELECT flw_subscription_id FROM users WHERE id = %s",
 837:             (user_id,)
 838:         )
 839:         result = cursor.fetchone()
 840:         cursor.close()
 841:         
 842:         if not result or not result[0]:
 843:             # No subscription to cancel
 844:             return True
 845:         
 846:         flw_subscription_id = result[0]
 847:         
 848:         # Cancel at Flutterwave
 849:         try:
 850:             response = requests.put(
 851:                 f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/subscriptions/{flw_subscription_id}/cancel',
 852:                 headers={
 853:                     'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
 854:                     'Content-Type': 'application/json'
 855:                 },
 856:                 timeout=30
 857:             )
 858:             
 859:             if response.status_code == 200:
 860:                 data = response.json()
 861:                 if data.get('status') == 'success':
 862:                     print(f"✅ Flutterwave subscription {flw_subscription_id} cancelled for user {user_id}")
 863:                     return True
 864:                 else:
 865:                     print(f"❌ Flutterwave cancellation failed: {data.get('message', 'Unknown error')}")
 866:                     return False
 867:             else:
 868:                 print(f"❌ HTTP error cancelling subscription: {response.status_code}")
 869:                 return False
 870:         except Exception as e:
 871:             print(f"❌ Error cancelling Flutterwave subscription: {e}")
 872:             return False
 873:             
 874:     except Exception as e:
 875:         print(f"❌ Error fetching subscription for user {user_id}: {e}")
 876:         return False
 877:     finally:
 878:         put_db(conn)
 879:

 881: # Helper to check if we're in test mode

 883:     """Check if Flutterwave is in test mode."""
 884:     return os.environ.get("FLW_TEST_MODE", "false").lower() == "true"

 895: @app.context_processor
 896: def inject_pricing():
 897:     """Make pricing available to every template without an IP lookup.
 898:     Region is populated by get_user_region() on /, /pricing, /subscribe, etc.
 899:     Falls back to 'us' (USD) so crawlers and new sessions still get sane prices."""
 900:     region = session.get('region', 'us')
 901:     return dict(pricing=get_pricing(region))

 904: # DECORATORS & AUTHENTICATION HELPERS

 906: 
 907: def require_verified():
 908:     """
 909:     Check if user is logged in AND their email is verified AND not suspended.
 910:     Returns a redirect if not, otherwise None.
 911:     """
 912:     if not session.get("user_id"):
 913:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
 914:     
 915:     user_id = session["user_id"]
 916:     
 917:     # Check if suspended
 918:     if is_user_suspended(user_id):
 919:         session.clear()
 920:         flash("❌ Your account has been suspended. Please contact support for assistance.", "error")
 921:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
 922:     
 923:     if not is_email_verified(user_id):
 924:         # User is logged in but not verified - redirect to verification page
 925:         flash("⚠️ Please verify your email address to access all features.", "warning")
 926:         return redirect(url_for("request_verification"))
 927:     
 928:     return None
 929: 
 930: def verify_flutterwave_webhook(data, signature):
 931:     """Verify webhook signature.
 932: 
 933:     Flutterwave's verif-hash header is NOT an HMAC of the payload —
 934:     it's the secret hash you configured in the dashboard, echoed back
 935:     verbatim. Verification is a plain constant-time string comparison.
 936:     """
 937:     webhook_secret = os.environ.get("FLW_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")
 938: 
 939:     if not webhook_secret:
 940:         print("❌ FLW_WEBHOOK_SECRET not set - rejecting webhook (fail closed)")
 941:         return False
 942: 
 943:     if not signature:
 944:         print("❌ No signature provided")
 945:         return False
 946: 
 947:     return hmac.compare_digest(webhook_secret, signature)
 948:

1221:             timeout=10
1222:         )
1223:         
1224:         if response.status_code >= 400:
1225:             print(f"Warning: Resend error sending welcome email: {response.text}")
1226:             return False
1227:         return True
1228:     except Exception as e:
1229:         print(f"Error sending welcome email: {e}")
1230:         return False
1231: 
1232: def send_subscription_expiry_email(user_email, user_name=None):
1233:     """Send email notification when subscription expires."""
1234:     try:
1235:         response = requests.post(
1236:             "https://api.resend.com/emails",
1237:             headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RESEND_API_KEY}"},
1238:             json={
1239:                 "from": RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
1240:                 "to": [user_email],
1241:                 "subject": "Your Fritt Tracker Subscription Has Expired",
1242:                 "html": f"""
1243:                     <h2>Your Subscription Has Expired</h2>
1244:                     <p>Your Fritt Tracker subscription has expired.</p>
1245:                     <p>You've been moved back to the Free plan with a 20-document limit.</p>
1246:                     <p>If you have more than 20 documents, we've kept your 20 most important ones.</p>
1247:                     <p><a href="https://tracker.fritt.org/pricing">Renew your subscription →</a></p>
1248:                 """,
1249:                 "text": f"""
1250:                     Your Fritt Tracker subscription has expired.
1251:                     
1252:                     You've been moved back to the Free plan with a 20-document limit.
1253:                     
1254:                     If you have more than 20 documents, we've kept your 20 most important ones.
1255:                     
1256:                     Renew your subscription: https://tracker.fritt.org/pricing
1257:                 """
1258:             },
1259:             timeout=10
1260:         )
1261:         return response.status_code < 400
1262:     except Exception as e:
1263:         print(f"Error sending expiry email: {e}")
1264:         return False

1271:     """Unauthorized - user isn't logged in but tried to access a protected page."""
1272:     # This will usually be caught by your require_login() redirect first,
1273:     # but just in case Flask's auth machinery triggers it:
1274:     return redirect(url_for('login'))

1299: @app.errorhandler(429)
1300: def ratelimit_handler(e):
1301:     """Return a user-friendly message when rate limit is exceeded."""
1302:     # e.description contains the custom error message
1303:     error_message = e.description if e.description else "Too many requests. Please slow down."
1304:     return render_template('errors/429.html', error_message=error_message), 429

1306: # =============================================================================
1307: # ROUTES - PUBLIC
1308: # =============================================================================
1309: @app.route("/")
1310: @limiter.exempt
1311: def home():
1312:     """Show landing page for non-logged-in users, dashboard for logged-in users."""
1313:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1314:         region = get_user_region()
1315:         pricing = get_pricing(region)
1316:         return render_template("landing.html", pricing=pricing)
1317: 
1318:     user_id = session["user_id"]
1319:     
1320:     # Check if suspended FIRST
1321:     if is_user_suspended(user_id):
1322:         session.clear()
1323:         flash("❌ Your account has been suspended. Please contact support.", "error")
1324:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
1325:     
1326:     # Get subscription status
1327:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
1328:     tier = sub_status['tier']
1329:     status = sub_status['status']
1330:     is_active = sub_status['is_active']
1331:     documents_trimmed = sub_status.get('documents_trimmed', False)
1332: 
1333:     # Check if trial has expired (for both Pro and VIP)
1334:     if tier in ['pro', 'vip'] and status == 'active' and sub_status.get('trial_used', False):
1335:         trial_ends_at = sub_status.get('trial_ends_at')
1336:         if trial_ends_at and trial_ends_at <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
1337:             # Trial expired - downgrade to free
1338:             conn = get_db()
1339:             try:
1340:                 cursor = conn.cursor()
1341:                 # Trim documents if over limit
1342:                 trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1343:                 cursor.execute("""
1344:                     UPDATE users 
1345:                     SET subscription_tier = 'free',
1346:                         subscription_status = 'expired',
1347:                         subscription_expiry = NULL,
1348:                         trial_ends_at = NULL
1349:                     WHERE id = %s
1350:                 """, (user_id,))
1351:                 conn.commit()
1352:                 cursor.close()
1353:                 flash("⚠️ Your free trial has ended. Upgrade to continue using Pro features.", "warning")
1354:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
1355:             except Exception as e:
1356:                 print(f"❌ Error ending trial: {e}")
1357:                 flash("An error occurred. Please contact support.", "error")
1358:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
1359:             finally:
1360:                 put_db(conn)
1361:     
1362:     # REMOVE GRACE PERIOD CODE - Just handle expired subscriptions directly
1363:     if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not is_active:
1364:         # Subscription expired - downgrade immediately
1365:         deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1366:         
1367:         conn = get_db()
1368:         try:
1369:             cursor = conn.cursor()
1370:             cursor.execute("""
1371:                 UPDATE users 
1372:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
1373:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
1374:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
1375:                     documents_trimmed = TRUE
1376:                 WHERE id = %s
1377:             """, (user_id,))
1378:             conn.commit()
1379:             cursor.close()
1380:         finally:
1381:             put_db(conn)
1382:         
1383:         if deleted_count > 0:
1384:             flash(
1385:                 f"⚠️ Your subscription has expired. We've kept your 20 most important documents "
1386:                 f"(farthest from expiry) and removed {deleted_count} documents. "
1387:                 f"Upgrade to Pro or VIP to track more than 20 documents.",
1388:                 "warning"
1389:             )
1390:         else:
1391:             flash("⚠️ Your subscription has expired. You're now on the Free plan.", "warning")
1392:         
1393:         # Refresh subscription status
1394:         sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
1395:         tier = sub_status['tier']
1396:         status = sub_status['status']
1397:         documents_trimmed = True
1398:     
1399:     # Get document count
1400:     doc_count = get_document_count(user_id)
1401:     
1402:     # If on free plan and over limit (shouldn't happen after trim, but just in case)
1403:     if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
1404:         deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1405:         if deleted_count > 0:
1406:             flash(
1407:                 f"⚠️ You have more than 20 documents on the Free plan. "
1408:                 f"We've kept your 20 most important documents (farthest from expiry) "
1409:                 f"and removed {deleted_count} documents. "
1410:                 f"Upgrade to Pro or VIP to track more than 20 documents.",
1411:                 "warning"
1412:             )
1413:             doc_count = get_document_count(user_id)
1414:     
1415:     search_query = request.args.get("q", "").strip()
1416:     status_filter = request.args.get("status", "")
1417: 
1418:     docs = get_documents(user_id, search_query)
1419:     documents = []
1420: 
1421:     for doc_id, title, expiry_date in docs:
1422:         days_left, doc_status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
1423: 
1424:         if status_filter and doc_status != status_filter:
1425:             continue
1426: 
1427:         if days_left < 0:
1428:             display_days = f"{abs(days_left)} days overdue"
1429:         else:
1430:             display_days = f"{days_left} days left"
1431: 
1432:         documents.append({
1433:             "id": doc_id,
1434:             "title": title,
1435:             "expiry_date": expiry_date,
1436:             "display_days": display_days,
1437:             "status": doc_status,
1438:             "color": color,
1439:             "icon": icon
1440:         })
1441: 
1442:     # ALWAYS return here at the end
1443:     return render_template(
1444:         "index.html", 
1445:         documents=documents, 
1446:         doc_count=doc_count,  
1447:         subscription_tier=tier,
1448:         subscription_status=status,
1449:         subscription_expiry=sub_status.get('expiry'),
1450:         on_trial=sub_status.get('on_trial', False),
1451:         trial_ends_at=sub_status.get('trial_ends_at'),
1452:         now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1453:     )
1454:

1458:     """Health check endpoint for UptimeRobot — no rate limit."""
1459:     return "OK", 200

1465: @app.route("/contact", methods=["GET", "POST"])
1466: @limiter.limit("10 per hour", error_message="Too many contact form submissions. Please try again later.")
1467: def contact():
1468:     """Contact page for support and business inquiries. Also handles
1469:     feedback submissions (routed here from /feedback so they share one
1470:     inquiries table and one notification/auto-reply pipeline)."""
1471:     error = None
1472:     success = None
1473: 
1474:     if request.method == "POST":
1475:         name = request.form.get("name", "").strip()
1476:         email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
1477:         subject = request.form.get("subject", "").strip()
1478:         message = request.form.get("message", "").strip()
1479:         inquiry_type = request.form.get("inquiry_type", "support")
1480:         is_feedback = inquiry_type == "feedback"
1481: 
1482:         # Validation
1483:         if not name:
1484:             error = "Please enter your name."
1485:         elif not email:
1486:             error = "Please enter your email address."
1487:         else:
1488:             try:
1489:                 validate_email(email)
1490:             except EmailNotValidError:
1491:                 error = "Please enter a valid email address."
1492: 
1493:         if not error and not subject:
1494:             error = "Please enter a subject."
1495:         elif not error and (not message or len(message) < 10):
1496:             error = "Please enter a message (at least 10 characters)."
1497: 
1498:         if not error:
1499:             try:
1500:                 # Store in database
1501:                 conn = get_db()
1502:                 try:
1503:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
1504:                     cursor.execute("""
1505:                         INSERT INTO contact_inquiries 
1506:                         (name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, created_at)
1507:                         VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1508:                         RETURNING id
1509:                     """, (name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, datetime.now(timezone.utc)))
1510:                     inquiry_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1511:                     conn.commit()
1512:                     cursor.close()
1513:                 finally:
1514:                     put_db(conn)
1515: 
1516:                 # Send notification to you (support@fritt.org or your personal email)
1517:                 send_inquiry_notification(name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, inquiry_id)
1518: 
1519:                 # Send auto-reply to user
1520:                 send_auto_reply(email, name, inquiry_type)
1521: 
1522:                 if is_feedback:
1523:                     flash("✅ Thanks for your feedback! We read every submission.", "success")
1524:                     return redirect(url_for("home"))
1525: 
1526:                 success = "✅ Your message has been sent! We'll get back to you within 24 hours."
1527: 
1528:             except Exception as e:
1529:                 print(f"❌ Error saving inquiry: {e}")
1530:                 error = "Something went wrong. Please try again later."
1531: 
1532:         # Validation failed, or the try block above raised before returning
1533:         if error and is_feedback:
1534:             return render_template("feedback.html", error=error)
1535: 
1536:     return render_template("contact.html", error=error, success=success)
1537: 
1538: @app.route("/business", methods=["GET", "POST"])
1539: @limiter.limit("10 per hour", error_message="Too many business inquiries. Please try again later.")
1540: def business():
1541:     """Business inquiries page."""
1542:     error = None
1543:     success = None
1544:     
1545:     if request.method == "POST":
1546:         name = request.form.get("name", "").strip()
1547:         email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
1548:         company = request.form.get("company", "").strip()
1549:         team_size = request.form.get("team_size", "")
1550:         message = request.form.get("message", "").strip()
1551:         
1552:         # Validation
1553:         if not name:
1554:             error = "Please enter your name."
1555:         elif not email:
1556:             error = "Please enter your email address."
1557:         else:
1558:             try:
1559:                 validate_email(email)
1560:             except EmailNotValidError:
1561:                 error = "Please enter a valid email address."
1562: 
1563:         if not error and not company:
1564:             error = "Please enter your company name."
1565:         elif not error and (not message or len(message) < 10):
1566:             error = "Please enter a message (at least 10 characters)."
1567: 
1568:         if not error:
1569:             try:
1570:                 # Store in database
1571:                 conn = get_db()
1572:                 try:
1573:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
1574:                     cursor.execute("""
1575:                         INSERT INTO business_inquiries 
1576:                         (name, email, company, team_size, message, created_at)
1577:                         VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1578:                         RETURNING id
1579:                     """, (name, email, company, team_size, message, datetime.now(timezone.utc)))
1580:                     inquiry_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1581:                     conn.commit()
1582:                     cursor.close()
1583:                 finally:
1584:                     put_db(conn)
1585:                 
1586:                 # Send notification to you
1587:                 send_business_inquiry_notification(name, email, company, team_size, message, inquiry_id)
1588:                 
1589:                 # Send auto-reply
1590:                 send_business_auto_reply(email, name)
1591:                 
1592:                 success = "✅ Thank you! A team member will contact you within 24 hours."
1593:                 
1594:             except Exception as e:
1595:                 print(f"❌ Error saving business inquiry: {e}")
1596:                 error = "Something went wrong. Please try again later."
1597:     
1598:     return render_template("business.html", error=error, success=success)

1600: def send_inquiry_notification(name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, inquiry_id):
1601:     """Send notification to you (the admin)."""
1602:     if not RESEND_API_KEY:
1603:         print(f"📧 New {inquiry_type} inquiry from {name} ({email}): {subject}")
1604:         return
1605:     
1606:     try:
1607:         # Send to your personal email (or support@fritt.org later)
1608:         if not ADMIN_EMAIL:
1609:             print(f"⚠️ WARNING: ADMIN_EMAIL not set. Inquiry from {email} was not sent.")
1610:             return
1611:         
1612:         response = requests.post(
1613:             "https://api.resend.com/emails",
1614:             headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RESEND_API_KEY}"},
1615:             json={
1616:                 "from": RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
1617:                 "to": [ADMIN_EMAIL],
1618:                 "reply_to": [email],
1619:                 "subject": f"[Fritt Tracker] New {inquiry_type} inquiry: {subject}",
1620:                 "html": f"""
1621:                     <h2>New {inquiry_type.capitalize()} Inquiry</h2>
1622:                     <p><strong>From:</strong> {name} ({email})</p>
1623:                     <p><strong>Subject:</strong> {subject}</p>
1624:                     <p><strong>Message:</strong></p>
1625:                     <p>{message.replace(chr(10), '<br>')}</p>
1626:                     <hr>
1627:                     <p><strong>Inquiry ID:</strong> #{inquiry_id}</p>
1628:                     <p><strong>Type:</strong> {inquiry_type}</p>
1629:                     <p>Reply directly to this email to respond to {name}.</p>
1630:                 """,
1631:                 "text": f"""
1632:                     New {inquiry_type} Inquiry
1633:                     
1634:                     From: {name} ({email})
1635:                     Subject: {subject}
1636:                     
1637:                     Message:
1638:                     {message}
1639:                     
1640:                     Inquiry ID: #{inquiry_id}
1641:                     Type: {inquiry_type}
1642:                 """
1643:             },
1644:             timeout=10
1645:         )
1646:         if response.status_code >= 400:
1647:             print(f"⚠️ Failed to send inquiry notification: {response.text}")
1648:     except Exception as e:
1649:         print(f"⚠️ Error sending inquiry notification: {e}")
1650:

1762: def send_business_inquiry_notification(name, email, company, team_size, message, inquiry_id):
1763:     """Send business inquiry notification to you."""
1764:     if not RESEND_API_KEY:
1765:         print(f"📧 New business inquiry from {name} ({email}) at {company}")
1766:         return
1767:     
1768:     try:
1769:         # Get admin email from env variables
1770:         if not ADMIN_EMAIL:
1771:             print(f"⚠️ WARNING: ADMIN_EMAIL not set. Inquiry from {email} was not sent.")
1772:             return
1773:         
1774:         response = requests.post(
1775:             "https://api.resend.com/emails",
1776:             headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RESEND_API_KEY}"},
1777:             json={
1778:                 "from": RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
1779:                 "to": [ADMIN_EMAIL],
1780:                 "reply_to": [email],
1781:                 "subject": f"[Fritt Tracker] Business Inquiry: {company}",
1782:                 "html": f"""
1783:                     <h2>New Business Inquiry</h2>
1784:                     <p><strong>Name:</strong> {name}</p>
1785:                     <p><strong>Email:</strong> {email}</p>
1786:                     <p><strong>Company:</strong> {company}</p>
1787:                     <p><strong>Team Size:</strong> {team_size or 'Not specified'}</p>
1788:                     <p><strong>Message:</strong></p>
1789:                     <p>{message.replace(chr(10), '<br>')}</p>
1790:                     <hr>
1791:                     <p><strong>Inquiry ID:</strong> #{inquiry_id}</p>
1792:                 """,
1793:                 "text": f"""
1794:                     New Business Inquiry
1795:                     
1796:                     Name: {name}
1797:                     Email: {email}
1798:                     Company: {company}
1799:                     Team Size: {team_size or 'Not specified'}
1800:                     
1801:                     Message:
1802:                     {message}
1803:                     
1804:                     Inquiry ID: #{inquiry_id}
1805:                 """
1806:             },
1807:             timeout=10
1808:         )
1809:         if response.status_code >= 400:
1810:             print(f"⚠️ Failed to send business inquiry notification: {response.text}")
1811:     except Exception as e:
1812:         print(f"⚠️ Error sending business inquiry notification: {e}")

1823: def require_admin():
1824:     """Decorator-like function to require admin access."""
1825:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1826:         flash("Please log in to access the admin area.", "warning")
1827:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
1828:     
1829:     if not is_admin():
1830:         flash("You don't have permission to access the admin area.", "error")
1831:         abort(403)
1832:     
1833:     return None
1834: 
1835: 
1836: def log_admin_action(action, target_type=None, target_id=None, details=None):
1837:     """Log admin actions for audit trail."""
1838:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1839:         return
1840:     
1841:     conn = get_db()
1842:     try:
1843:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1844:         cursor.execute("""
1845:             INSERT INTO audit_log 
1846:             (admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, details, ip_address, user_agent)
1847:             VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1848:         """, (
1849:             session["user_id"],
1850:             action,
1851:             target_type,
1852:             target_id,
1853:             json.dumps(details) if details else None,
1854:             request.remote_addr,
1855:             request.headers.get('User-Agent')
1856:         ))
1857:         conn.commit()
1858:         cursor.close()
1859:     finally:
1860:         put_db(conn)

1863: @app.route("/admin")
1864: def admin_dashboard():
1865:     """Admin dashboard - overview of everything."""
1866:     auth = require_admin()
1867:     if auth:
1868:         return auth
1869:     
1870:     conn = get_db()
1871:     try:
1872:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1873:         
1874:         # Get stats
1875:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users")
1876:         total_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1877:         
1878:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email_verified = TRUE")
1879:         verified_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1880:         
1881:         cursor.execute("""
1882:             SELECT subscription_tier, COUNT(*) 
1883:             FROM users 
1884:             GROUP BY subscription_tier
1885:         """)
1886:         subscription_stats = cursor.fetchall()
1887:         
1888:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents")
1889:         total_documents = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1890:         
1891:         cursor.execute("""
1892:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents 
1893:             WHERE expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE
1894:         """)
1895:         expired_documents = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1896:         
1897:         cursor.execute("""
1898:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents 
1899:             WHERE expiry_date::date > CURRENT_DATE 
1900:             AND expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '14 days'
1901:         """)
1902:         expiring_soon = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1903:         
1904:         cursor.execute("""
1905:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flagged_users WHERE status = 'pending'
1906:         """)
1907:         pending_flags = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1908:         
1909:         cursor.execute("""
1910:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_inquiries WHERE status = 'new'
1911:         """)
1912:         pending_inquiries = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1913:         
1914:         cursor.execute("""
1915:             SELECT id, email, subscription_tier, email_verified, created_at,
1916:                    trial_used, trial_ends_at,
1917:                    subscription_status, subscription_expiry
1918:             FROM users
1919:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
1920:             LIMIT 10
1921:         """)
1922:         raw_recent_users = cursor.fetchall()
1923: 
1924:         cursor.execute("""
1925:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users
1926:             WHERE trial_used = TRUE
1927:             AND trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL
1928:             AND trial_ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
1929:             AND subscription_status = 'active'
1930:         """)
1931:         trial_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1932:         
1933:         cursor.close()
1934:         
1935:     finally:
1936:         put_db(conn)
1937: 
1938:     # Enrich recent_users with display info.
1939:     # Raw layout (indices 0..8):
1940:     #   [0]=id, [1]=email, [2]=tier, [3]=verified, [4]=created_at,
1941:     #   [5]=trial_used, [6]=trial_ends_at, [7]=subscription_status,
1942:     #   [8]=subscription_expiry
1943:     # Enriched: [9]=display_label, [10]=is_trial, [11]=is_trial_expired, [12]=is_expired
1944:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1945:     recent_users = []
1946:     for row in raw_recent_users:
1947:         row = list(row)
1948:         label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired = compute_display_plan(
1949:             tier=row[2],
1950:             status=row[7],
1951:             trial_used=row[5],
1952:             trial_ends_at=row[6],
1953:             subscription_expiry=row[8],
1954:             now=now,
1955:         )
1956:         row.extend([label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired])
1957:         recent_users.append(tuple(row))
1958:     
1959:     return render_template(
1960:         "admin/dashboard.html",
1961:         total_users=total_users,
1962:         verified_users=verified_users,
1963:         subscription_stats=subscription_stats,
1964:         total_documents=total_documents,
1965:         expired_documents=expired_documents,
1966:         expiring_soon=expiring_soon,
1967:         pending_flags=pending_flags,
1968:         pending_inquiries=pending_inquiries,
1969:         recent_users=recent_users,
1970:         trial_count=trial_count,
1971:         now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1972:     )

1975: @app.route("/admin/users")
1976: def admin_users():
1977:     """View and manage all users."""
1978:     auth = require_admin()
1979:     if auth:
1980:         return auth
1981: 
1982:     search = request.args.get("search", "")
1983:     status = request.args.get("status", "all")
1984:     page = int(request.args.get("page", 1))
1985:     per_page = 20
1986:     offset = (page - 1) * per_page
1987: 
1988:     conn = get_db()
1989:     try:
1990:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1991: 
1992:         # Build query
1993:         query = """
1994:             SELECT u.id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.subscription_tier,
1995:                 u.subscription_status, u.created_at,
1996:                 COUNT(d.id) as doc_count,
1997:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) as is_admin,
1998:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending') as is_flagged,
1999:                 u.trial_used,
2000:                 u.trial_ends_at
2001:             FROM users u
2002:             LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.user_id = u.id
2003:         """
2004:         where_clauses = []
2005:         params = []
2006: 
2007:         if search:
2008:             where_clauses.append("u.email ILIKE %s")
2009:             params.append(f"%{search}%")
2010: 
2011:         if status == "verified":
2012:             where_clauses.append("u.email_verified = TRUE")
2013:         elif status == "unverified":
2014:             where_clauses.append("u.email_verified = FALSE")
2015:         elif status == "flagged":
2016:             where_clauses.append(
2017:                 "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending')"
2018:             )
2019:         elif status == "admin":
2020:             where_clauses.append(
2021:                 "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id)"
2022:             )
2023: 
2024:         if where_clauses:
2025:             query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where_clauses)
2026: 
2027:         query += " GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT %s OFFSET %s"
2028:         params.extend([per_page, offset])
2029: 
2030:         cursor.execute(query, params)
2031:         raw_users = cursor.fetchall()
2032: 
2033:         # Get total count for pagination
2034:         count_query = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u"
2035:         if where_clauses:
2036:             count_query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where_clauses)
2037:         cursor.execute(count_query, params[:-2])  # Exclude LIMIT/OFFSET
2038:         total_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2039: 
2040:         cursor.close()
2041: 
2042:     finally:
2043:         put_db(conn)
2044: 
2045:     # Enrich each row with computed display info.
2046:     # Raw row layout (indices 0..10):
2047:     #   [0]=id, [1]=email, [2]=verified, [3]=tier, [4]=sub_status,
2048:     #   [5]=created_at, [6]=doc_count, [7]=is_admin, [8]=is_flagged,
2049:     #   [9]=trial_used, [10]=trial_ends_at
2050:     # Enriched row appends:
2051:     #   [11]=display_label, [12]=is_trial, [13]=is_trial_expired, [14]=is_expired
2052:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
2053:     users = []
2054:     for row in raw_users:
2055:         row = list(row)
2056:         label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired = compute_display_plan(
2057:             tier=row[3],
2058:             status=row[4],
2059:             trial_used=row[9],
2060:             trial_ends_at=row[10],
2061:             subscription_expiry=None,  # not selected here; not needed by this view
2062:             now=now,
2063:         )
2064:         row.extend([label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired])
2065:         users.append(tuple(row))
2066: 
2067:     return render_template(
2068:         "admin/users.html",
2069:         users=users,
2070:         total_users=total_users,
2071:         page=page,
2072:         per_page=per_page,
2073:         search=search,
2074:         status=status,
2075:         now=now,
2076:     )
2077: 
2078: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>")
2079: def admin_user_detail(user_id):
2080:     """View detailed user information."""
2081:     auth = require_admin()
2082:     if auth:
2083:         return auth
2084: 
2085:     conn = get_db()
2086:     try:
2087:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2088: 
2089:         cursor.execute("""
2090:             SELECT u.id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.subscription_tier,
2091:                 u.subscription_status, u.subscription_expiry, u.created_at,
2092:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) as is_admin,
2093:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending') as is_flagged,
2094:                 u.trial_used,
2095:                 u.trial_ends_at
2096:             FROM users u
2097:             WHERE u.id = %s
2098:         """, (user_id,))
2099:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2100: 
2101:         if not user:
2102:             abort(404)
2103: 
2104:         # Convert expiry to timezone-aware if needed
2105:         if user[5] and user[5].tzinfo is None:
2106:             user = list(user)
2107:             user[5] = user[5].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
2108:             user = tuple(user)
2109: 
2110:         # Get user documents - just get the raw data
2111:         cursor.execute("""
2112:             SELECT id, title, expiry_date
2113:             FROM documents
2114:             WHERE user_id = %s
2115:             ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
2116:         """, (user_id,))
2117:         raw_documents = cursor.fetchall()
2118: 
2119:         documents = []
2120:         for doc_id, title, expiry_date in raw_documents:
2121:             days_left, status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
2122:             documents.append({
2123:                 'id': doc_id,
2124:                 'title': title,
2125:                 'expiry_date': expiry_date,
2126:                 'days_left': days_left,
2127:                 'status': status,
2128:                 'color': color,
2129:                 'icon': icon,
2130:             })
2131: 
2132:         # Get user activity logs
2133:         cursor.execute("""
2134:             SELECT action, details, created_at
2135:             FROM user_activity_logs
2136:             WHERE user_id = %s
2137:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
2138:             LIMIT 50
2139:         """, (user_id,))
2140:         activity_logs = cursor.fetchall()
2141: 
2142:         # Get audit logs for this user
2143:         cursor.execute("""
2144:             SELECT action, target_type, details, created_at
2145:             FROM audit_log
2146:             WHERE target_type = 'user' AND target_id = %s
2147:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
2148:             LIMIT 20
2149:         """, (user_id,))
2150:         audit_logs = cursor.fetchall()
2151: 
2152:         cursor.close()
2153: 
2154:     finally:
2155:         put_db(conn)
2156: 
2157:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
2158: 
2159:     # Enrich user row with computed display info.
2160:     # Raw layout: [0..10] same as above
2161:     # Appended:   [11]=display_label, [12]=is_trial, [13]=is_trial_expired, [14]=is_expired
2162:     user = list(user)
2163:     label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired = compute_display_plan(
2164:         tier=user[3],
2165:         status=user[4],
2166:         trial_used=user[9],
2167:         trial_ends_at=user[10],
2168:         subscription_expiry=user[5],
2169:         now=now,
2170:     )
2171:     user.extend([label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired])
2172:     user = tuple(user)
2173: 
2174:     return render_template(
2175:         "admin/user_detail.html",
2176:         user=user,
2177:         documents=documents,
2178:         activity_logs=activity_logs,
2179:         audit_logs=audit_logs,
2180:         now=now,
2181:     )

2183: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/action", methods=["POST"])
2184: def admin_user_action(user_id):
2185:     """Perform actions on a user (suspend, verify, make admin, etc.)."""
2186:     auth = require_admin()
2187:     if auth:
2188:         return auth
2189:     
2190:     action = request.form.get("action")
2191:     
2192:     if not action:
2193:         flash("No action specified.", "error")
2194:         return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))
2195:     
2196:     conn = get_db()
2197:     try:
2198:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2199:         
2200:         if action == "verify_email":
2201:             cursor.execute(
2202:                 "UPDATE users SET email_verified = TRUE WHERE id = %s",
2203:                 (user_id,)
2204:             )
2205:             conn.commit()
2206:             log_admin_action("verify_email", "user", user_id, {"action": "verified_email"})
2207:             flash("✅ User email verified successfully.", "success")
2208:             
2209:         elif action == "make_admin":
2210:             cursor.execute(
2211:                 "INSERT INTO admin_users (user_id) VALUES (%s) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING",
2212:                 (user_id,)
2213:             )
2214:             conn.commit()
2215:             log_admin_action("make_admin", "user", user_id, {"action": "made_admin"})
2216:             flash("✅ User is now an admin.", "success")
2217:             
2218:         elif action == "remove_admin":
2219:             cursor.execute(
2220:                 "DELETE FROM admin_users WHERE user_id = %s",
2221:                 (user_id,)
2222:             )
2223:             conn.commit()
2224:             log_admin_action("remove_admin", "user", user_id, {"action": "removed_admin"})
2225:             flash("✅ Admin privileges removed.", "success")
2226:             
2227:         elif action == "flag_user":
2228:             reason = request.form.get("reason", "No reason provided")
2229:             cursor.execute("""
2230:                 INSERT INTO flagged_users (user_id, flagged_by, reason, status)
2231:                 VALUES (%s, %s, %s, 'pending')
2232:             """, (user_id, session["user_id"], reason))
2233:             conn.commit()
2234:             log_admin_action("flag_user", "user", user_id, {"reason": reason})
2235:             flash("⚠️ User has been flagged for review.", "warning")
2236:             
2237:         elif action == "resolve_flag":
2238:             cursor.execute("""
2239:                 UPDATE flagged_users 
2240:                 SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = %s, notes = %s
2241:                 WHERE user_id = %s AND status = 'pending'
2242:             """, (datetime.now(timezone.utc), request.form.get("notes", ""), user_id))
2243:             conn.commit()
2244:             log_admin_action("resolve_flag", "user", user_id, {"action": "resolved_flag"})
2245:             flash("✅ Flag resolved.", "success")
2246: 
2247:         elif action == "suspend_user":
2248:             # Cancel their subscription at Flutterwave first
2249:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
2250:             if not cancel_success:
2251:                 flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")
2252:             
2253:             # Just mark as suspended, keep all subscription info intact
2254:             cursor.execute("""
2255:                 UPDATE users 
2256:                 SET suspended = TRUE,
2257:                     subscription_status = 'cancelled',
2258:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
2259:                 WHERE id = %s
2260:             """, (user_id,))
2261:             conn.commit()
2262:             
2263:             log_admin_action("suspend_user", "user", user_id, {"action": "suspended"})
2264:             flash("⚠️ User has been suspended. Their subscription will be reactivated when unsuspended.", "warning")
2265: 
2266:         elif action == "unsuspend_user":
2267:             # Get user info before unsuspending
2268:             cursor.execute(
2269:                 "SELECT subscription_tier, subscription_status, subscription_expiry FROM users WHERE id = %s AND suspended = TRUE",
2270:                 (user_id,)
2271:             )
2272:             user_info = cursor.fetchone()
2273:             
2274:             if user_info:
2275:                 current_tier, current_status, current_expiry = user_info
2276:                 
2277:                 # Check if they have a valid subscription
2278:                 has_valid_subscription = False
2279:                 if current_tier in ['pro', 'vip', 'business']:
2280:                     if current_status in ['active', 'cancelled'] and current_expiry and current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
2281:                         has_valid_subscription = True
2282:                     elif current_status in ['active', 'cancelled'] and current_expiry is None:
2283:                         has_valid_subscription = True
2284:                 
2285:                 if has_valid_subscription:
2286:                     # Reactivate the subscription
2287:                     cursor.execute("""
2288:                         UPDATE users 
2289:                         SET suspended = FALSE,
2290:                             subscription_status = 'active',
2291:                             documents_trimmed = FALSE
2292:                         WHERE id = %s
2293:                     """, (user_id,))
2294:                     conn.commit()
2295:                     
2296:                     log_admin_action("unsuspend_user", "user", user_id, {
2297:                         "action": "unsuspended",
2298:                         "subscription_reactivated": True,
2299:                         "tier": current_tier
2300:                     })
2301:                     
2302:                     flash(f"✅ User unsuspended and {current_tier.upper()} subscription reactivated!", "success")
2303:                 else:
2304:                     # No valid subscription - just unsuspend to free
2305:                     cursor.execute("""
2306:                         UPDATE users 
2307:                         SET suspended = FALSE,
2308:                             subscription_tier = 'free',
2309:                             subscription_status = 'active'
2310:                         WHERE id = %s
2311:                     """, (user_id,))
2312:                     conn.commit()
2313:                     
2314:                     log_admin_action("unsuspend_user", "user", user_id, {
2315:                         "action": "unsuspended",
2316:                         "subscription_reactivated": False,
2317:                         "tier": "free"
2318:                     })
2319:                     
2320:                     flash("✅ User unsuspended and set to Free plan. No active subscription found.", "success")
2321:             else:
2322:                 # Fallback - just unsuspend
2323:                 cursor.execute("""
2324:                     UPDATE users 
2325:                     SET suspended = FALSE
2326:                     WHERE id = %s
2327:                 """, (user_id,))
2328:                 conn.commit()
2329:                 log_admin_action("unsuspend_user", "user", user_id, {"action": "unsuspended"})
2330:                 flash("✅ User unsuspended.", "success")
2331: 
2332:         elif action == "upgrade_user":
2333:             new_tier = request.form.get("new_tier")
2334:             duration = request.form.get("duration", "indefinite")
2335:             
2336:             if new_tier not in ['pro']:
2337:                 flash("Invalid tier selected.", "error")
2338:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))
2339:             
2340:             # Calculate expiry based on duration
2341:             if duration == "indefinite":
2342:                 expiry = None
2343:                 expiry_display = "Indefinite"
2344:             else:
2345:                 duration_map = {
2346:                     '1_month': 30,
2347:                     '3_months': 90,
2348:                     '6_months': 180,
2349:                     '1_year': 365
2350:                 }
2351:                 days = duration_map.get(duration, 30)
2352:                 expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=days)
2353:                 expiry_display = expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')
2354:             
2355:             # ✅ Add debug logging
2356:             print(f"🔄 Upgrading user {user_id} to {new_tier} with duration {duration}, expiry: {expiry}")
2357:             
2358:             cursor.execute("""
2359:                 UPDATE users 
2360:                 SET subscription_tier = %s,
2361:                     subscription_status = 'active',
2362:                     subscription_expiry = %s,
2363:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
2364:                 WHERE id = %s
2365:             """, (new_tier, expiry, user_id))
2366:             conn.commit()
2367:             
2368:             # ✅ Verify the update
2369:             cursor.execute("SELECT subscription_expiry FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2370:             result = cursor.fetchone()
2371:             print(f"✅ After update, expiry is: {result[0] if result else 'NOT FOUND'}")
2372:             
2373:             log_admin_action("upgrade_user", "user", user_id, {
2374:                 "new_tier": new_tier, 
2375:                 "duration": duration,
2376:                 "expiry": expiry_display
2377:             })
2378:             
2379:             flash(f"✅ User upgraded to {new_tier.capitalize()} plan ({expiry_display})", "success")
2380:             
2381:         elif action == "downgrade_user":
2382:             new_tier = request.form.get("new_tier")
2383:             if new_tier != 'free':
2384:                 flash("Only free downgrade is supported.", "error")
2385:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))
2386:             
2387:             # Cancel their subscription first
2388:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
2389:             if not cancel_success:
2390:                 flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")
2391:             
2392:             # Trim documents to free limit
2393:             deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2394:             
2395:             cursor.execute("""
2396:                 UPDATE users 
2397:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
2398:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
2399:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
2400:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
2401:                 WHERE id = %s
2402:             """, (user_id,))
2403:             conn.commit()
2404:             log_admin_action("downgrade_user", "user", user_id, {"deleted_documents": deleted_count})
2405:             flash(f"✅ User downgraded to Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents. Subscription cancelled.", "success")
2406: 
2407:         elif action == "force_fix":
2408:             # Force a subscription check and cleanup
2409:             sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
2410:             tier = sub_status['tier']
2411:             
2412:             # Check if subscription expired or we need to downgrade
2413:             if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not sub_status['is_active']:
2414:                 # Cancel the subscription
2415:                 cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
2416:                 if not cancel_success:
2417:                     flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")
2418:                 
2419:                 deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2420:                 cursor.execute("""
2421:                     UPDATE users 
2422:                     SET subscription_tier = 'free', 
2423:                         subscription_status = 'expired',
2424:                         subscription_expiry = NULL,
2425:                         flw_subscription_id = NULL
2426:                     WHERE id = %s
2427:                 """, (user_id,))
2428:                 conn.commit()
2429:                 flash(f"✅ User forced to Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents. Subscription cancelled.", "success")
2430:             else:
2431:                 # Just check and trim if over limit on free
2432:                 cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2433:                 doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2434:                 if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
2435:                     deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2436:                     flash(f"⚠️ User had {doc_count} documents on Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "warning")
2437:                 else:
2438:                     flash(f"✅ User is on {tier} plan with {doc_count} documents. No issues found.", "success")
2439:             
2440:             log_admin_action("force_fix", "user", user_id, {"action": "force_fix_subscription"})
2441: 
2442:         elif action == "delete_user":
2443:             # FIRST: Cancel their subscription at Flutterwave
2444:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
2445:             if not cancel_success:
2446:                 flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")
2447:             
2448:             # Delete user and all their data
2449:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2450:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM flagged_users WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2451:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM admin_users WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2452:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2453:             conn.commit()
2454:             log_admin_action("delete_user", "user", user_id, {"action": "deleted_user"})
2455:             flash("🗑️ User and all associated data deleted. Subscription cancelled.", "warning")
2456:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2457: 
2458:         cursor.close()
2459:         
2460:     except Exception as e:
2461:         conn.rollback()
2462:         flash(f"Error performing action: {str(e)}", "error")
2463:     finally:
2464:         put_db(conn)
2465:     
2466:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))

2468: @app.route("/admin/inquiries")
2469: def admin_inquiries():
2470:     """View all contact inquiries."""
2471:     auth = require_admin()
2472:     if auth:
2473:         return auth
2474:     
2475:     status_filter = request.args.get("status", "all")
2476:     
2477:     conn = get_db()
2478:     try:
2479:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2480:         
2481:         query = """
2482:             SELECT id, name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, status, created_at
2483:             FROM contact_inquiries
2484:         """
2485:         params = []
2486:         
2487:         if status_filter != "all":
2488:             query += " WHERE status = %s"
2489:             params.append(status_filter)
2490:         
2491:         query += " ORDER BY created_at DESC"
2492:         
2493:         cursor.execute(query, params)
2494:         inquiries = cursor.fetchall()
2495:         cursor.close()
2496:         
2497:     finally:
2498:         put_db(conn)
2499:     
2500:     return render_template(

2571: @app.route("/admin/documents")
2572: def admin_documents():
2573:     """View all documents across all users, grouped by user."""
2574:     auth = require_admin()
2575:     if auth:
2576:         return auth
2577:     
2578:     conn = get_db()
2579:     try:
2580:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2581:         cursor.execute("""
2582:             SELECT d.id, d.title, d.expiry_date, d.user_id, u.email
2583:             FROM documents d
2584:             JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
2585:             ORDER BY u.email ASC, d.expiry_date ASC
2586:             LIMIT 100
2587:         """)
2588:         raw_documents = cursor.fetchall()
2589:         cursor.close()
2590:         
2591:         # Process documents through get_status() for consistency
2592:         documents = []
2593:         for doc_id, title, expiry_date, user_id, email in raw_documents:
2594:             days_left, status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
2595:             documents.append({
2596:                 'id': doc_id,
2597:                 'title': title,
2598:                 'expiry_date': expiry_date,
2599:                 'user_id': user_id,
2600:                 'email': email,
2601:                 'days_left': days_left,
2602:                 'status': status,
2603:                 'color': color,
2604:                 'icon': icon
2605:             })
2606:         
2607:     finally:
2608:         put_db(conn)
2609:     
2610:     return render_template("admin/documents.html", documents=documents)

2636: @app.route("/admin/fix-user/<int:user_id>")
2637: def admin_fix_user(user_id):
2638:     """Force a subscription check and cleanup for a user."""
2639:     auth = require_admin()
2640:     if auth:
2641:         return auth
2642:     
2643:     # Check if user exists
2644:     conn = get_db()

2646:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2647:         cursor.execute("SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2648:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2649:         if not user:
2650:             flash("User not found.", "error")
2651:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2652:         
2653:         # Force subscription check
2654:         sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
2655:         tier = sub_status['tier']
2656:         
2657:         if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not sub_status['is_active']:
2658:             deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2659:             cursor.execute("""
2660:                 UPDATE users 
2661:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free', 
2662:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
2663:                     subscription_expiry = NULL
2664:                 WHERE id = %s
2665:             """, (user_id,))
2666:             conn.commit()
2667:             flash(f"✅ User {user[0]} downgraded to Free. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "success")
2668:         else:
2669:             # Just check and trim if over limit
2670:             cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2671:             doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2672:             if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
2673:                 deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2674:                 flash(f"⚠️ User had {doc_count} documents on Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "warning")
2675:             else:
2676:                 flash(f"✅ User {user[0]} is on {tier} plan with {doc_count} documents. No changes needed.", "success")
2677:         
2678:         cursor.close()
2679:     finally:
2680:         put_db(conn)
2681:     
2682:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))

2751: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/document/<int:doc_id>/delete", methods=["POST"])
2752: def admin_delete_user_document(user_id, doc_id):
2753:     """Delete a document on behalf of a user."""
2754:     auth = require_admin()
2755:     if auth:
2756:         return auth
2757:     
2758:     conn = get_db()
2759:     try:
2760:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2761:         
2762:         # Verify document belongs to user
2763:         cursor.execute(
2764:             "SELECT title FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2765:             (doc_id, user_id)
2766:         )
2767:         doc = cursor.fetchone()
2768:         if not doc:
2769:             flash("Document not found or doesn't belong to this user.", "error")
2770:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2771:         
2772:         # Delete the document
2773:         cursor.execute(
2774:             "DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2775:             (doc_id, user_id)
2776:         )
2777:         conn.commit()
2778:         
2779:         log_admin_action("admin_delete_document", "document", doc_id, {"user_id": user_id, "title": doc[0]})
2780:         flash(f"✅ Document '{doc[0]}' deleted successfully.", "success")
2781:         
2782:     except Exception as e:
2783:         conn.rollback()
2784:         flash(f"Error deleting document: {str(e)}", "error")
2785:     finally:
2786:         put_db(conn)
2787:     
2788:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))

2791: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/document/<int:doc_id>/renew", methods=["GET", "POST"])
2792: def admin_renew_user_document(user_id, doc_id):
2793:     """Renew a document on behalf of a user."""
2794:     auth = require_admin()
2795:     if auth:
2796:         return auth
2797:     
2798:     conn = get_db()
2799:     try:
2800:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2801:         
2802:         # Get document info
2803:         cursor.execute(
2804:             "SELECT title, expiry_date FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2805:             (doc_id, user_id)
2806:         )
2807:         doc = cursor.fetchone()
2808:         if not doc:
2809:             flash("Document not found or doesn't belong to this user.", "error")
2810:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2811:         
2812:         if request.method == "POST":
2813:             new_expiry = request.form.get("expiry_date")
2814:             
2815:             if not new_expiry:
2816:                 flash("Please select a new expiry date.", "error")
2817:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_renew_user_document", user_id=user_id, doc_id=doc_id))
2818:             
2819:             try:
2820:                 datetime.strptime(new_expiry, "%Y-%m-%d")
2821:             except ValueError:
2822:                 flash("Invalid date format.", "error")
2823:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_renew_user_document", user_id=user_id, doc_id=doc_id))
2824:             
2825:             cursor.execute("""
2826:                 UPDATE documents 
2827:                 SET expiry_date = %s, 
2828:                     last_reminder_sent = NULL, 
2829:                     reminder_state = NULL, 
2830:                     snoozed_until = NULL 
2831:                 WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s
2832:             """, (new_expiry, doc_id, user_id))
2833:             conn.commit()
2834:             
2835:             log_admin_action("admin_renew_document", "document", doc_id, {"user_id": user_id, "new_expiry": new_expiry})
2836:             flash(f"✅ Document '{doc[0]}' renewed successfully to {new_expiry}.", "success")
2837:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2838:         
2839:         cursor.close()
2840:         
2841:     finally:
2842:         put_db(conn)
2843:     
2844:     return render_template(
2845:         "admin/renew_documents.html",
2846:         user_id=user_id,
2847:         doc_id=doc_id,
2848:         doc=doc
2849:     )

2854: @app.route("/admin/reset-test-account", methods=["POST"])
2855: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many reset attempts. Please wait.")
2856: def admin_reset_test_account():
2857:     """Admin-only endpoint to reset a test account."""
2858:     auth = require_admin()
2859:     if auth:
2860:         return auth
2861:     
2862:     email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
2863:     
2864:     if not email:
2865:         flash("Please provide an email address.", "error")
2866:         return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2867:     
2868:     # Security: Only allow resetting the configured test account
2869:     if ALLOWED_TEST_EMAIL:
2870:         if email != ALLOWED_TEST_EMAIL.lower():
2871:             flash(f"Only the configured test account can be reset.", "error")
2872:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2873:     else:
2874:         if email != 'test@fritt.org':
2875:             flash("Only test accounts can be reset. Set TEST_EMAIL env variable to configure.", "error")
2876:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2877:     
2878:     conn = get_db()
2879:     try:
2880:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2881:         
2882:         cursor.execute(
2883:             "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email = %s",
2884:             (email,)
2885:         )
2886:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2887:         
2888:         if not user:
2889:             flash(f"User with email '{email}' not found.", "error")
2890:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2891:         
2892:         user_id = user[0]
2893:         
2894:         cursor.execute(
2895:             "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s",
2896:             (user_id,)
2897:         )
2898:         doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2899:         
2900:         cursor.execute("DELETE FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2901:         deleted_docs = cursor.rowcount
2902:         
2903:         cursor.execute("DELETE FROM user_activity_logs WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2904:         cursor.execute("DELETE FROM flagged_users WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2905:         
2906:         cursor.execute("""
2907:             UPDATE users 
2908:             SET 
2909:                 email_verified = FALSE,
2910:                 reset_token = NULL,
2911:                 reset_token_expiry = NULL,
2912:                 verification_token = NULL,
2913:                 verification_token_expiry = NULL,
2914:                 email_verification_sent_at = NULL,
2915:                 subscription_tier = 'free',
2916:                 subscription_status = 'active',
2917:                 subscription_expiry = NULL,
2918:                 flw_subscription_id = NULL,
2919:                 documents_trimmed = FALSE,
2920:                 trial_used = FALSE,
2921:                 trial_ends_at = NULL,
2922:                 suspended = FALSE
2923:             WHERE id = %s
2924:             RETURNING email
2925:         """, (user_id,))
2926:         
2927:         updated_user = cursor.fetchone()
2928:         conn.commit()
2929:         
2930:         log_admin_action("reset_test_account", "user", user_id, {
2931:             "email": email,
2932:             "documents_deleted": deleted_docs,
2933:             "previous_doc_count": doc_count
2934:         })
2935:         
2936:         flash(
2937:             f"✅ Account {email} reset successfully! Deleted {deleted_docs} documents. "
2938:             "Account is now unverified, on free tier, with no documents.",
2939:             "success"
2940:         )
2941:         
2942:     except Exception as e:
2943:         conn.rollback()
2944:         print(f"❌ Error resetting account: {e}")
2945:         flash(f"Error resetting account: {str(e)}", "error")
2946:     finally:
2947:         put_db(conn)
2948:     
2949:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))

2951: @app.route("/pricing")
2952: @limiter.exempt
2953: def pricing():
2954:     """Pricing page showing subscription tiers."""
2955:     region = get_user_region()
2956:     pricing = get_pricing(region)
2957:     
2958:     subscription_tier = 'free'
2959:     subscription_expiry = None
2960:     doc_count = 0
2961:     
2962:     # Get billing period from query parameter (default: monthly)
2963:     billing_period = request.args.get("billing", "monthly")
2964:     if billing_period not in ['monthly', 'annual']:
2965:         billing_period = 'monthly'
2966:     
2967:     if session.get('user_id'):

3010: @app.route("/register", methods=["GET", "POST"])
3011: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many registration attempts. Please try again later.")
3012: def register():
3013:     """User registration."""
3014:     error = None
3015:     if request.method == "POST":
3016:         email = request.form["email"].strip().lower()
3017:         password = request.form["password"]
3018: 
3019:         password_errors = validate_password_strength(password)
3020:         if password_errors:
3021:             error = f"Password must contain: {', '.join(password_errors)}"
3022:         else:
3023:             conn = get_db()
3024:             try:
3025:                 cursor = conn.cursor()
3026:                 cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = %s", (email,))
3027:                 if cursor.fetchone():
3028:                     error = "An account with that email already exists"
3029:                 else:
3030:                     password_hash = generate_password_hash(password)
3031:                     cursor.execute(

3033:                         (email, password_hash, False)
3034:                     )
3035:                     new_user_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
3036:                     conn.commit()
3037:

3039:                     send_verification_email(email, new_user_id)
3040:

3042:                     session["user_id"] = new_user_id
3043:                     session["email"] = email
3044:                     
3045:                     cursor.close()

3047:                 put_db(conn)

3071:                 (user_id,)
3072:             )

3083:             return redirect("/")

3086:                 "SELECT id, email_verified FROM users WHERE verification_token = %s",

3108: @app.route("/request-verification", methods=["GET", "POST"])

3113:     success = None
3114:     
3115:     # If user is logged in, pre-fill their email

3140: 
3141:                 if not email_verified:

3143:                         success = "✅ A verification email has been sent. Please check your inbox."

3492: @app.route("/bulk-delete", methods=["POST"])
3493: @limiter.limit(lambda: "3 per day" if session.get('user_id') and get_user_tier(session.get('user_id')) in ['free'] else "10 per day")
3494: def bulk_delete_documents():
3495:     """Delete multiple documents at once with safety confirmations."""
3496:     auth = require_verified()
3497:     if auth:
3498:         return auth
3499:     
3500:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3501:     
3502:     # Get subscription tier for limits
3503:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3504:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3505:     
3506:     # Get document IDs from form
3507:     doc_ids = request.form.getlist("document_ids")
3508:     
3509:     if not doc_ids:
3510:         flash("No documents selected for deletion.", "error")
3511:         return redirect("/")
3512:     
3513:     # Limit check based on tier
3514:     MAX_BULK_DELETE = {
3515:         'free': 5,
3516:         'pro': 50,
3517:         'vip': 999,  # Essentially unlimited
3518:         'business': 999
3519:     }
3520:     
3521:     max_allowed = MAX_BULK_DELETE.get(tier, 5)
3522:     if len(doc_ids) > max_allowed:
3523:         flash(f"⚠️ You can only delete {max_allowed} documents at a time on the {tier.capitalize()} plan. Upgrade to delete more at once.", "warning")
3524:         return redirect("/")
3525:     
3526:     # Verify all documents belong to the user
3527:     conn = get_db()
3528:     try:
3529:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3530:         
3531:         # Get the actual document titles for the confirmation message
3532:         placeholders = ','.join(['%s'] * len(doc_ids))
3533:         cursor.execute(
3534:             f"SELECT id, title FROM documents WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) AND user_id = %s",
3535:             doc_ids + [user_id]
3536:         )
3537:         docs_to_delete = cursor.fetchall()
3538:         
3539:         # Check if any IDs were invalid (belonged to someone else)
3540:         if len(docs_to_delete) != len(doc_ids):
3541:             flash("Some documents could not be found or don't belong to you.", "error")
3542:             return redirect("/")
3543:         
3544:         # Get titles for flash message
3545:         titles = [doc[1] for doc in docs_to_delete]
3546:         doc_ids_to_delete = [str(doc[0]) for doc in docs_to_delete]
3547:         
3548:         # Delete the documents
3549:         placeholders = ','.join(['%s'] * len(doc_ids_to_delete))
3550:         cursor.execute(
3551:             f"DELETE FROM documents WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) AND user_id = %s",
3552:             doc_ids_to_delete + [user_id]
3553:         )
3554:         deleted_count = cursor.rowcount
3555:         conn.commit()
3556:         
3557:         if deleted_count > 0:
3558:             # Log the bulk deletion
3559:             log_user_action(user_id, "bulk_delete_documents", {
3560:                 "count": deleted_count,
3561:                 "titles": titles[:5],  # Only store first 5 to avoid huge logs
3562:                 "total": len(titles),
3563:                 "tier": tier
3564:             })
3565:             
3566:             if deleted_count == 1:
3567:                 flash(f"✅ Document '{titles[0]}' deleted successfully.", "success")
3568:             else:
3569:                 flash(f"✅ {deleted_count} documents deleted successfully.", "success")
3570:         else:
3571:             flash("No documents were deleted.", "warning")

3579:     finally:
3580:         put_db(conn)

3636: @app.route("/import-csv", methods=["GET", "POST"])
3637: @limiter.limit(lambda: "20 per day" if session.get('user_id') and get_user_tier(session['user_id']) == 'vip' else "5 per day")
3638: def import_csv():
3639:     """Import documents from CSV file."""
3640:     auth = require_verified()
3641:     if auth:
3642:         return auth
3643:     
3644:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3645:     
3646:     # Check if user is on a paid plan
3647:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3648:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3649:     
3650:     # Only Pro, VIP, and Business can import CSV
3651:     if tier not in ['pro', 'vip', 'business']:
3652:         flash("📥 CSV import is a Pro feature. Upgrade to import multiple documents at once!", "warning")
3653:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3654: 
3655:     error = None
3656: 
3657:     if request.method == "POST":
3658:         if 'csv_file' not in request.files:
3659:             error = "Please upload a CSV file."
3660:         else:
3661:             file = request.files['csv_file']
3662:             
3663:             if file.filename == '':
3664:                 error = "No file selected."
3665:             elif not file.filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
3666:                 error = "Please upload a CSV file (.csv)."
3667:             else:
3668:                 try:
3669:                     stream = io.StringIO(file.stream.read().decode("UTF-8"), newline=None)
3670:                     csv_input = csv.reader(stream)
3671:                     
3672:                     headers = [h.strip().lower().replace(' ', '_') for h in next(csv_input)]
3673:                     
3674:                     title_match = None
3675:                     expiry_match = None
3676:                     
3677:                     for i, h in enumerate(headers):
3678:                         if h in ['title', 'document', 'document_title', 'doc_title', 'name']:
3679:                             title_match = i
3680:                         if h in ['expiry_date', 'expiry', 'expiration', 'expiration_date']:
3681:                             expiry_match = i
3682:                     
3683:                     if title_match is None:
3684:                         error = f"CSV must have a 'title' column. Found: {', '.join(headers)}"
3685:                     elif expiry_match is None:
3686:                         error = f"CSV must have an 'expiry_date' column. Found: {', '.join(headers)}"
3687:                     else:
3688:                         conn = get_db()
3689:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
3690:                         added = 0
3691:                         failed = 0
3692:                         
3693:                         for row in csv_input:
3694:                             if not row or all(cell.strip() == '' for cell in row):
3695:                                 continue
3696:                             
3697:                             title = row[title_match].strip() if len(row) > title_match else ""
3698:                             expiry_date = row[expiry_match].strip() if len(row) > expiry_match else ""
3699:                             
3700:                             if not title or not expiry_date:
3701:                                 failed += 1
3702:                                 continue
3703:                             
3704:                             try:
3705:                                 datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
3706:                             except ValueError:
3707:                                 try:
3708:                                     parsed = datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%d/%m/%Y")
3709:                                     expiry_date = parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
3710:                                 except ValueError:
3711:                                     try:
3712:                                         parsed = datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%m/%d/%Y")
3713:                                         expiry_date = parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
3714:                                     except ValueError:
3715:                                         failed += 1
3716:                                         continue
3717:                             
3718:                             try:
3719:                                 cursor.execute(
3720:                                     "INSERT INTO documents (title, expiry_date, user_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)",
3721:                                     (title, expiry_date, session["user_id"])
3722:                                 )
3723:                                 added += 1
3724:                             except Exception:
3725:                                 failed += 1
3726:                         
3727:                         conn.commit()
3728:                         cursor.close()
3729:                         put_db(conn)
3730:                         
3731:                         if added > 0:
3732:                             flash(f"✅ Successfully imported {added} documents! {failed} failed.", "success")
3733:                         else:
3734:                             flash(f"⚠️ No documents imported. {failed} rows had errors.", "error")
3735:                             
3736:                         return redirect("/")
3737:                         
3738:                 except csv.Error as e:
3739:                     error = f"CSV error: {str(e)}"
3740:                 except Exception as e:
3741:                     error = f"Error reading file: {str(e)}"
3742: 
3743:     return render_template("import_csv.html", error=error)

3852: def cancel_flutterwave_subscription(flw_subscription_id):
3853:     """
3854:     Cancel a subscription at Flutterwave.
3855:     Returns True if successful, False otherwise.
3856:     """
3857:     if not flw_subscription_id:
3858:         print("⚠️ No Flutterwave subscription ID to cancel")
3859:         return True  # No subscription to cancel
3860:     
3861:     try:
3862:         response = requests.put(
3863:             f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/subscriptions/{flw_subscription_id}/cancel',
3864:             headers={
3865:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
3866:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
3867:             },
3868:             timeout=30
3869:         )
3870:         
3871:         if response.status_code == 200:
3872:             data = response.json()
3873:             if data.get('status') == 'success':
3874:                 print(f"✅ Flutterwave subscription {flw_subscription_id} cancelled")
3875:                 return True
3876:             else:
3877:                 print(f"❌ Flutterwave cancellation failed: {data.get('message', 'Unknown error')}")
3878:                 return False
3879:         else:
3880:             print(f"❌ HTTP error cancelling subscription: {response.status_code}")
3881:             return False
3882:     except Exception as e:
3883:         print(f"❌ Error cancelling Flutterwave subscription: {e}")
3884:         return False
