3887: @app.route("/cancel-subscription", methods=["POST"])
3888: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many cancellation attempts. Please wait.")
3889: def cancel_subscription():
3890:     """Cancel user's subscription."""
3891:     auth = require_verified()
3892:     if auth:
3893:         return auth
3894:     
3895:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3896:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3897:     
3898:     if sub_status['tier'] == 'free':
3899:         flash("You're already on the Free plan.", "info")
3900:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
3901:     
3902:     # Get current expiry and Flutterwave subscription ID before cancelling
3903:     current_expiry = sub_status.get('expiry')
3904:     flw_subscription_id = sub_status.get('flw_subscription_id')
3905:     
3906:     conn = get_db()
3907:     try:
3908:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3909:         
3910:         # FIRST: Cancel at Flutterwave
3911:         if flw_subscription_id:
3912:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
3913:             if not cancel_success:
3914:                 flash("Could not cancel subscription at Flutterwave. Please contact support.", "error")
3915:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
3916:         
3917:         # SECOND: Update our database
3918:         if current_expiry and current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
3919:             # Keep access until expiry, just mark as cancelled
3920:             cursor.execute("""
3921:                 UPDATE users 
3922:                 SET subscription_status = 'cancelled',
3923:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
3924:                 WHERE id = %s
3925:             """, (user_id,))
3926:             conn.commit()
3927:             
3928:             days_left = (current_expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days
3929:             flash(f"✅ Your subscription has been cancelled. You'll have {sub_status['tier'].upper()} access until {current_expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} ({days_left} days remaining).", "success")
3930:         else:
3931:             # If no expiry or already expired, downgrade immediately
3932:             cursor.execute("""
3933:                 UPDATE users 
3934:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
3935:                     subscription_status = 'cancelled',
3936:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
3937:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
3938:                 WHERE id = %s
3939:             """, (user_id,))
3940:             conn.commit()
3941:             flash("✅ Your subscription has been cancelled. You're now on the Free plan.", "success")
3942:         
3943:         cursor.close()
3944:         
3945:     except Exception as e:
3946:         print(f"❌ Error cancelling subscription: {e}")
3947:         conn.rollback()
3948:         flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
3949:     finally:
3950:         put_db(conn)
3951:     
3952:     return redirect(url_for("home"))

3954: @app.route("/reactivate-subscription", methods=["POST"])
3955: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many reactivation attempts. Please wait.")
3956: def reactivate_subscription():
3957:     """Reactivate a cancelled subscription."""
3958:     auth = require_verified()
3959:     if auth:
3960:         return auth
3961:     
3962:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3963:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3964:

3969:     
3970:     # CASE 1: Already active → Just inform user
3971:     if status == 'active':
3972:         flash("Your subscription is already active.", "info")
3973:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
3974:     
3975:     # CASE 2: On free plan (documents trimmed) → Can't reactivate

3977:         flash("Your subscription has expired. Please purchase a new subscription.", "warning")
3978:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3979:     
3980:     # CASE 3: Admin-upgraded with no expiry → Reactivate immediately!
3981:     if current_expiry is None:
3982:         conn = get_db()
3983:         try:
3984:             cursor = conn.cursor()
3985:             cursor.execute("""
3986:                 UPDATE users 
3987:                 SET subscription_status = 'active'
3988:                 WHERE id = %s
3989:             """, (user_id,))
3990:             conn.commit()
3991:             cursor.close()
3992:             flash(f"✅ Your {tier.upper()} subscription has been reactivated!", "success")
3993:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
3994:         except Exception as e:
3995:             print(f"❌ Error reactivating: {e}")
3996:             conn.rollback()
3997:             flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
3998:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
3999:     
4000:     # CASE 4: Has expiry and is still valid → Reactivate!
4001:     if current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
4002:         conn = get_db()
4003:         try:
4004:             cursor = conn.cursor()
4005:             cursor.execute("""
4006:                 UPDATE users 
4007:                 SET subscription_status = 'active'
4008:                 WHERE id = %s
4009:             """, (user_id,))
4010:             conn.commit()
4011:             cursor.close()
4012:             
4013:             days_left = (current_expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days
4014:             flash(f"✅ Your {tier.upper()} subscription has been reactivated! Access until {current_expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} ({days_left} days remaining).", "success")
4015:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
4016:         except Exception as e:
4017:             print(f"❌ Error reactivating: {e}")
4018:             conn.rollback()
4019:             flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
4020:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
4021:     
4022:     # CASE 5: Expired - Can't reactivate
4023:     flash("Your subscription has expired. Please purchase a new subscription.", "warning")
4024:     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))

4026: @app.route("/payment/initiate", methods=["POST"])
4027: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many payment initiations. Please wait before trying again.")
4028: def initiate_payment():
4029:     """Initialize Flutterwave payment."""
4030:     auth = require_verified()
4031:     if auth:
4032:         return auth
4033:     
4034:     plan_id = request.form.get("plan_id")
4035:     plan_type = request.form.get("plan_type")
4036:     
4037:     if not plan_id or not plan_type:
4038:         flash("Invalid payment request.", "error")
4039:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4040:     
4041:     region = get_user_region()
4042:     currency = get_currency_for_region(region)
4043:     pricing = get_pricing(region)
4044:     
4045:     amount_map = {
4046:         'pro_monthly': pricing['monthly_raw'],
4047:         'pro_yearly': pricing['yearly_raw'],
4048:         'vip_monthly': pricing['vip_monthly_raw'],
4049:         'vip_yearly': pricing['vip_yearly_raw'],
4050:     }
4051:     
4052:     amount = amount_map.get(plan_type, 0)
4053:     if amount <= 0:
4054:         flash("Invalid payment amount.", "error")
4055:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4056:     
4057:     try:
4058:         base_url = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "tracker.fritt.org")
4059:         redirect_url = f"https://{base_url}{url_for('payment_callback')}"
4060:         
4061:         tx_ref = f"fritt_{session['user_id']}_{int(time.time())}"
4062:         
4063:         payload = {
4064:             'amount': str(amount),
4065:             'currency': currency,
4066:             'tx_ref': tx_ref,
4067:             'payment_plan': int(plan_id),
4068:             'redirect_url': redirect_url,
4069:             'customer': {
4070:                 'email': session['email'],
4071:                 'name': session.get('email', 'Customer').split('@')[0],
4072:             },
4073:             'meta': {
4074:                 'user_id': session['user_id'],
4075:                 'plan_type': plan_type,
4076:                 'region': region
4077:             },
4078:             'payment_options': 'card,banktransfer,ussd,mobilemoney,qr',  # Still works with payment_plan
4079:         }
4080:         
4081:         print(f"🔍 Sending payment request: {payload}")
4082:         
4083:         # Use test or live endpoint
4084:         api_base = "https://api.flutterwave.com/v3"
4085:         if is_test_mode():
4086:             print("🔧 Running in TEST MODE")
4087:         else:
4088:             print("🚀 Running in LIVE MODE")
4089: 
4090:         response = requests.post(
4091:             f'{api_base}/payments',
4092:             headers={
4093:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
4094:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
4095:             },
4096:             json=payload,
4097:             timeout=30
4098:         )
4099:         
4100:         print(f"📨 Flutterwave response status: {response.status_code}")
4101:         print(f"📨 Flutterwave response: {response.text[:500]}...")
4102:         
4103:         if response.status_code == 200:
4104:             data = response.json()
4105:             if data.get('status') == 'success':
4106:                 session['tx_ref'] = tx_ref
4107:                 
4108:                 link = data['data'].get('link')
4109:                 if link:
4110:                     return redirect(link)
4111:                 else:
4112:                     flash("Payment link not found.", "error")
4113:                     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4114:             else:
4115:                 error_message = data.get('message', 'Unknown error')
4116:                 print(f"❌ Flutterwave error: {error_message}")
4117:                 flash(f"Payment initialization failed: {error_message}", "error")
4118:                 return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4119:         else:
4120:             print(f"❌ HTTP Error: {response.status_code}")
4121:             print(f"❌ Response: {response.text}")
4122:             flash("Payment initialization failed. Please try again.", "error")
4123:             return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4124:         
4125:     except Exception as e:
4126:         print(f"❌ Payment error: {e}")
4127:         import traceback
4128:         traceback.print_exc()
4129:         flash("Payment initialization failed. Please try again.", "error")
4130:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))

4133: @app.route("/payment/callback")
4134: @limiter.exempt
4135: def payment_callback():
4136:     """Handle payment callback from Flutterwave."""
4137:     auth = require_verified()
4138:     if auth:
4139:         return auth
4140:     
4141:     tx_ref = request.args.get('tx_ref')
4142:     transaction_id = request.args.get('transaction_id')
4143:     
4144:     if not tx_ref or not transaction_id:
4145:         flash("Invalid payment callback.", "error")
4146:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4147:     
4148:     try:
4149:         # Check if we're in test mode vs live mode
4150:         is_test_mode = os.environ.get("FLW_TEST_MODE", "false").lower() == "true"
4151:         
4152:         response = requests.get(
4153:             f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/transactions/{transaction_id}/verify',
4154:             headers={
4155:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
4156:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
4157:             },
4158:             timeout=30
4159:         )
4160:         
4161:         if response.status_code == 200:
4162:             data = response.json()
4163:             
4164:             if data.get('status') == 'success' and data['data']['status'] == 'successful':
4165:                 # Skip test mode transactions in production
4166:                 if data['data'].get('test_mode', False) and not is_test_mode:
4167:                     flash("Test payments are not allowed in production.", "error")
4168:                     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4169:                 
4170:                 user_id = session['user_id']
4171:                 
4172:                 meta = data['data'].get('meta', {})
4173:                 plan_type = meta.get('plan_type', '')
4174:                 
4175:                 if not plan_type:
4176:                     payment_plan = data['data'].get('payment_plan', {})
4177:                     plan_name = payment_plan.get('name', '')
4178:                     if 'Pro' in plan_name:
4179:                         plan_type = 'pro_monthly' if 'Monthly' in plan_name else 'pro_yearly'
4180:                     elif 'VIP' in plan_name:
4181:                         plan_type = 'vip_monthly' if 'Monthly' in plan_name else 'vip_yearly'
4182:                 
4183:                 tier = plan_type.split('_')[0] if plan_type else 'pro'
4184:                 
4185:                 # Get the Flutterwave subscription ID from the response
4186:                 # This comes from the payment_plan subscription
4187:                 flw_subscription_id = data['data'].get('subscription_id') or data['data'].get('payment_plan_id')
4188:                 
4189:                 # If we don't have a subscription_id, we need to fetch it
4190:                 if not flw_subscription_id:
4191:                     # Try to get subscription from the transaction
4192:                     transaction_data = data['data']
4193:                     if transaction_data.get('payment_plan'):
4194:                         # The subscription might be in the payment_plan object
4195:                         flw_subscription_id = transaction_data.get('payment_plan', {}).get('id')
4196:                 
4197:                 # Calculate expiry based on plan type
4198:                 # Flutterwave handles the recurring billing, but we track it in our DB too
4199:                 if '_yearly' in plan_type:
4200:                     expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=365)
4201:                 else:
4202:                     expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)
4203:                 
4204:                 conn = get_db()
4205:                 try:
4206:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
4207:                     cursor.execute("""
4208:                         UPDATE users 
4209:                         SET subscription_tier = %s,
4210:                             subscription_status = 'active',
4211:                             subscription_expiry = %s,
4212:                             flw_subscription_id = %s
4213:                         WHERE id = %s
4214:                     """, (tier, expiry, flw_subscription_id, user_id))
4215:                     conn.commit()
4216:                     cursor.close()
4217:                     print(f"✅ User {user_id} upgraded to {tier} (expires {expiry}, FLW ID: {flw_subscription_id})")
4218:                 finally:
4219:                     put_db(conn)
4220:                 
4221:                 flash("✅ Payment successful! Your subscription is now active.", "success")
4222:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
4223:             else:
4224:                 flash("Payment failed. Please try again.", "error")
4225:                 return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4226:         else:
4227:             flash("Error verifying payment. Please contact support.", "error")
4228:             return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4229:             
4230:     except Exception as e:
4231:         print(f"❌ Callback error: {e}")
4232:         import traceback
4233:         traceback.print_exc()
4234:         flash("Error verifying payment. Please contact support.", "error")
4235:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))

4251: @app.route("/webhook/flutterwave", methods=["POST"])
4252: @csrf.exempt
4253: @limiter.exempt
4254: def flutterwave_webhook():
4255:     """Handle Flutterwave webhook for subscription events."""
4256:     try:
4257:         data = request.json
4258:         if not data:
4259:             print("❌ No JSON data received")
4260:             return "No data", 400
4261:         
4262:         print(f"📨 Webhook received at {datetime.now(timezone.utc)}")
4263:         print(f"📨 Event: {data.get('event', 'unknown')}")
4264:         print(f"📨 Full data: {data}")
4265:         
4266:         signature = request.headers.get('verif-hash')
4267: 
4268:         # --- CRITICAL: Enable Signature Verification ---
4269:         if not verify_flutterwave_webhook(data, signature):
4270:             print("❌ Webhook signature verification failed.")
4271:             return "Invalid Signature", 401
4272:         # -------------------------------------------------
4273: 
4274:         if signature:
4275:             print(f"📨 Signature: {signature[:20]}...")
4276:         
4277:         try:
4278:             event = data.get('event')
4279:             
4280:             if event == 'charge.completed':
4281:                 print("✅ Payment completed webhook received")
4282:                 
4283:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4284: 
4285:                 # --- Reject test/mock transactions when not running in test mode ---
4286:                 if webhook_data.get('test_mode', False) and not is_test_mode():
4287:                     print("⚠️ Ignoring test-mode webhook transaction in production")
4288:                     return "OK", 200
4289:                 # -------------------------------------------------------------------
4290:                 
4291:                 user_id = None
4292:                 plan_type = None
4293:                 meta = webhook_data.get('meta', {})
4294:                 if meta:
4295:                     user_id = meta.get('user_id')
4296:                     plan_type = meta.get('plan_type', 'pro_monthly')
4297:                 
4298:                 if not user_id:
4299:                     customer = webhook_data.get('customer', {})
4300:                     email = customer.get('email')
4301:                     if email:
4302:                         print(f"📨 Looking up user by email: {email}")
4303:                         user = get_user_by_email(email)
4304:                         if user:
4305:                             user_id = user[0]
4306:                 
4307:                 if user_id:
4308:                     tier = plan_type.split('_')[0] if plan_type else 'pro'
4309:                     
4310:                     # Calculate expiry
4311:                     if '_yearly' in plan_type:
4312:                         expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=365)
4313:                     else:
4314:                         expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)
4315:                     
4316:                     # Get subscription ID from webhook
4317:                     flw_subscription_id = webhook_data.get('subscription_id') or webhook_data.get('payment_plan_id')
4318:                     
4319:                     conn = get_db()
4320:                     try:
4321:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4322:                         cursor.execute("""
4323:                             UPDATE users 
4324:                             SET subscription_tier = %s,
4325:                                 subscription_status = 'active',
4326:                                 subscription_expiry = %s,
4327:                                 flw_subscription_id = %s
4328:                             WHERE id = %s
4329:                         """, (tier, expiry, flw_subscription_id, user_id))
4330:                         conn.commit()
4331:                         cursor.close()
4332:                         print(f"✅ User {user_id} upgraded to {tier} via webhook (expires {expiry})")
4333:                     except Exception as db_error:
4334:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4335:                     finally:
4336:                         put_db(conn)
4337:                 else:
4338:                     print(f"⚠️ Could not find user for webhook: {data}")
4339:             
4340:             elif event == 'subscription.cancelled':
4341:                 print("❌ Subscription cancelled webhook received")
4342:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4343:                 
4344:                 # Find user by subscription ID
4345:                 subscription_id = webhook_data.get('id')
4346:                 if subscription_id:
4347:                     conn = get_db()
4348:                     try:
4349:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4350:                         cursor.execute("""
4351:                             UPDATE users 
4352:                             SET subscription_status = 'cancelled'
4353:                             WHERE flw_subscription_id = %s
4354:                         """, (subscription_id,))
4355:                         conn.commit()
4356:                         print(f"✅ User with FLW subscription {subscription_id} marked as cancelled")
4357:                     except Exception as db_error:
4358:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4359:                     finally:
4360:                         put_db(conn)
4361:             
4362:             elif event == 'subscription.expired':
4363:                 print("⏰ Subscription expired webhook received")
4364:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4365:                 
4366:                 # Find user by subscription ID and downgrade
4367:                 subscription_id = webhook_data.get('id')
4368:                 if subscription_id:
4369:                     conn = get_db()
4370:                     try:
4371:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4372:                         cursor.execute("""
4373:                             SELECT id FROM users WHERE flw_subscription_id = %s
4374:                         """, (subscription_id,))
4375:                         user_result = cursor.fetchone()
4376:                         
4377:                         if user_result:
4378:                             user_id = user_result[0]
4379:                             # Trim documents to free limit
4380:                             trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
4381:                             cursor.execute("""
4382:                                 UPDATE users 
4383:                                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
4384:                                     subscription_status = 'expired',
4385:                                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
4386:                                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
4387:                                 WHERE id = %s
4388:                             """, (user_id,))
4389:                             conn.commit()
4390:                             print(f"✅ User {user_id} downgraded to Free via webhook")
4391:                     except Exception as db_error:
4392:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4393:                     finally:
4394:                         put_db(conn)
4395:             
4396:             else:
4397:                 print(f"ℹ️ Unhandled webhook event: {event}")
4398:                 
4399:         except Exception as process_error:
4400:             print(f"❌ Error processing webhook: {process_error}")
4401:             import traceback
4402:             traceback.print_exc()
4403:         
4404:         return "OK", 200
4405:         
4406:     except Exception as e:
4407:         print(f"❌ Webhook error: {e}")
4408:         import traceback
4409:         traceback.print_exc()
4410:         return "OK", 200

4412: @app.route("/cron/reminders")
4413: @limiter.exempt  # Cron jobs should NEVER be rate limited
4414: def run_reminders():
4415:     """Endpoint triggered by cron-job.org to send daily reminders."""
4416:     provided_token = request.args.get("token") or request.headers.get("X-Trigger-Token")
4417:     
4418:     if provided_token != TRIGGER_SECRET:
4419:         abort(401, "Unauthorized: Invalid token")
4420:     
4421:     try:
4422:         import reminders
4423:         reminders.check_and_send_reminders()
4424:         return "✅ Reminders sent successfully.", 200
4425:     except Exception as e:
4426:         return f"❌ Reminders failed: {str(e)}", 500

4432: @app.route("/newsletter/subscribe", methods=["POST"])
4433: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many subscription attempts. Please wait an hour.")
4434: def subscribe_newsletter():
4435:     """Subscribe to newsletter."""
4436:     email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
4437:     
4438:     if not email:
4439:         flash("Please enter your email address.", "error")
4440:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
4441:     
4442:     conn = get_db()
4443:     try:
4444:         cursor = conn.cursor()
4445:         cursor.execute(
4446:             "INSERT INTO newsletter_subscribers (email, subscribed_at) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING",
4447:             (email, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
4448:         )
4449:         conn.commit()
4450:         cursor.close()
4451:     finally:
4452:         put_db(conn)
4453:     
4454:     flash("✅ Thanks for subscribing! You'll hear from us soon.", "success")
4455:     return redirect(url_for("home"))

4470:         cursor.close()
4471:     finally:
4472:         put_db(conn)

4483: def _base_url():
4484:     """Return the canonical base URL (with scheme)."""
4485:     base = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "tracker.fritt.org")
4486:     if not base.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
4487:         base = f"https://{base}"
4488:     return base.rstrip("/")

4558: @app.route("/sitemap.xml")
4559: @limiter.exempt
4560: def sitemap():
4561:     """Generate sitemap.xml for search engines."""
4562:     from flask import Response
4563: 
4564:     base = _base_url()
4565:     today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
4566: 
4567:     static_pages = [
4568:         ("/", "1.0", "weekly"),
4569:         ("/pricing", "0.9", "weekly"),
4570:         ("/business", "0.8", "monthly"),
4571:         ("/resources", "0.9", "weekly"),
4572:         ("/use-cases", "0.8", "weekly"),
4573:         ("/compare/spreadsheets-vs-fritt-tracker", "0.8", "monthly"),
4574:         ("/contact", "0.5", "monthly"),
4575:         ("/feedback", "0.4", "monthly"),
4576:         ("/terms", "0.2", "yearly"),
4577:         ("/privacy", "0.2", "yearly"),
4578:     ]
4579: 
4580:     xml = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>']
4581:     xml.append('<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">')
4582: 
4583:     for path, priority, freq in static_pages:
4584:         xml.append(
4585:             f"  <url>\n"
4586:             f"    <loc>{base}{path}</loc>\n"
4587:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4588:             f"    <changefreq>{freq}</changefreq>\n"
4589:             f"    <priority>{priority}</priority>\n"
4590:             f"  </url>"
4591:         )
4592: 
4593:     for a in RESOURCE_ARTICLES:
4594:         xml.append(
4595:             f"  <url>\n"
4596:             f"    <loc>{base}/resources/{a['slug']}</loc>\n"
4597:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4598:             f"    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n"
4599:             f"    <priority>0.7</priority>\n"
4600:             f"  </url>"
4601:         )
4602: 
4603:     for u in USE_CASES:
4604:         xml.append(
4605:             f"  <url>\n"
4606:             f"    <loc>{base}/use-cases/{u['slug']}</loc>\n"
4607:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4608:             f"    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n"
4609:             f"    <priority>0.7</priority>\n"
4610:             f"  </url>"
4611:         )
4612: 
4613:     xml.append("</urlset>")
4614:     return Response("\n".join(xml), mimetype="application/xml")

4731: @app.route("/compare/spreadsheets-vs-fritt-tracker")
4732: @limiter.exempt
4733: def compare_spreadsheets():
4734:     return render_template("compare/vs-spreadsheets.html")
4735:

4737: # APPLICATION ENTRY POINT
4738: # =============================================================================
4739: 
4740: if __name__ == "__main__":
4741:     debug_mode = os.environ.get("FLASK_DEBUG", "False").lower() == "true"
4742:     app.run(debug=False)
